items.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a an Analyst to join our GTM Analytics team, where we turn data into the insights that shape decisions across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, and more. Most of your work will be answering business questions directly — pulling and structuring data, summarizing it clearly, and delivering a recommendation. When a request genuinely calls for a dashboard, you'll help scope the requirements and hand them off to our central data team to build. In this role, you'll work on well-scoped, clearly framed requests — writing SQL to pull data, looking up how a metric is already built in Looker or Omni when one exists, using Claude to refine and debug your queries, and shaping the output in Excel or Google Sheets into something a stakeholder can act on. This is a developmental role: as you build experience, you'll take on progressively more ambiguous and higher-stakes requests. This is a full-time position based out of our Costa Rica office. Technologies You’ll Use SQL, Excel and/or Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, formulas), Claude (or similar AI assistants), Salesforce (viewing/reading data) — exposure to BI tools like Looker, Omni, Sigma, or Hex is a plus What You’ll Do Write and adapt SQL queries against well-defined requests, using Claude to refine logic and troubleshoot errors Look up existing metrics in Looker or Omni to understand how they're already built, and reuse that logic where it applies Pull, clean, and structure data in Excel or Google Sheets to answer scoped stakeholder questions Summarize findings into clear, plain-language takeaways for non-technical stakeholders Validate data accuracy against source systems before sharing outputs Ask clarifying questions to properly scope a request before starting work Escalate requests that require deeper analytical judgment to senior team members Maintain documentation of recurring requests and their underlying logic Support ad hoc reporting needs across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, among others Build working knowledge of dbt Labs' GTM data model (Salesforce objects, opportunity stages, fiscal calendar) Skills We’re Looking For Working knowledge of SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, basic aggregate functions) Comfortable using AI tools like Claude to write, debug, or refine queries and analysis Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, formulas) Clear written and verbal communication skills in English Basic understanding of SaaS sales concepts (opportunity stages, pipeline) Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work Comfortable asking questions rather than guessing at ambiguous requests Comfortable navigating existing Looker or Omni dashboards to trace how a metric is defined and built Bonus Skills​ Experience building in BI or exploratory-analysis tools like Looker, Omni, Sigma, or Hex (not required — happy to teach this on the job) Familiarity with Salesforce Prior internship or role in analytics, RevOps, or FP&A Basic Python #LI-MM1 #LI-Remote Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.description: Role Description We are looking for a data-driven, systems-thinking Sales Operations Manager to own the operating infrastructure that powers our go-to-market engine. In this highly visible Individual Contributor role, you will serve as the backbone of a regional Sales organization and translate go-to-market strategy into an executable operating model. You will act as the primary regional business partner for sales executives, supporting all routes to market within the region. You will own or coordinate supporting sales planning, territory and quota execution, forecast interpretation, operational improvements, and translation of strategic priorities into clear execution plans. You’ll drive process clarity, pipeline health, forecasting hygiene, and cross-functional governance, using AI and automation-enabled workflows to reduce manual reporting effort while maintaining strong human judgment over business recommendations. Your top priority each day will be to ensure excellence in execution and reporting on our regional goals. Responsibilities Own the operating cadence, including territory management, account segmentation, forecasting governance, pipeline inspection, business reviews, and performance visibility, delivering executive-ready insights that drive forecast accuracy, balanced sales coverage, and operational excellence.Partner with regional Sales leaders across all routes to market to improve forecast accuracy, pipeline health, sales coverage, deal quality, and operational execution. Work in close partnership with the Chief Business Officer’s organization and the GTM Strategy & Programs team to connect regional Sales Operations to company-wide priorities, provide timely inputs for executive reporting, and ensure consistency across regional and corporate operating cadences. Lead end-to-end coverage design, including segmentation, book cutting, territory planning, account assignment, capacity planning, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales Leadership, Compensation, Finance, Systems, and Analytics. Own CRM QA and hygiene for the supported region, including SFDC hierarchy management, pipeline quality, process compliance, forecast integrity, deal quality investigations, and exception resolution. Partner with leadership on pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity assessment, and build executive-ready reporting, dashboards, MBR/QBR readouts, and business insights that help leaders identify risks and make better decisions. Partner with Sales Strategy, Systems, Analytics, Compensation, Finance, and Enablement to automate recurring workflows and continuously improve how the team operates. Support organization design, interim coverage plans, role changes, new-hire onboarding, SPIF development and administration, and Channel deal registration as part of the regional operating model. Requirements Proven experience scaling Sales Operations across Europe, supporting a complex, multi-country sales organization with diverse markets, languages, and evolving go-to-market motions. Professional working proficiency in English is required as this role regularly collaborates with global teams 8+ years of experience in sales operations, business strategy, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or corporate advisory, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree. 4+ years of experience working with executive stakeholders. Experience leading territory planning, account segmentation, forecasting, pipeline inspection, and annual sales planning processes. Deep understanding of quota planning, sales capacity modeling, and quota governance, with the ability to align quotas to business strategy and commercial objectives. Experience using AI, automation, and analytics tools to improve forecasting, pipeline inspection, reporting, and workflow efficiency, with the ability to validate outputs and apply sound business judgment before making recommendations. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. The role can be based in either the UK or Ireland. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting executive operating cadences (e.g., Weekly Business Reviews, Forecast Calls, Quarterly Business Reviews) for senior sales leadership. Experience designing or optimizing territory, account segmentation, or book-of-business models for high-growth SaaS organizations. Experience developing quota methodologies, allocating quotas, and partnering with Sales Leadership and Finance to align quotas with territory design, capacity planning, and business objectives. Experience supporting multiple sales motions (Direct, Channel, Self-Serve, Enterprise) across global or multi-region organizations. Strong proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, SQL, or similar business intelligence and CRM platforms. Experience operating in a high-growth or transformational environment where Sales Operations played a strategic role in scaling the business. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: Understand yourself and others. Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. Compensation United Kingdom Pay Range £91,400—£123,600 GBP Ireland Pay Range €93.500—€126.500 EUR

items.description: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About us Orchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services. Our products cover escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and independent dispute resolution for healthcare payments under the federal No Surprises Act. Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and Latin America, with a few colleagues further afield. We work remotely, in writing, and across time zones. About the role This is our first dedicated data and business intelligence role. You will own reporting end to end: the data model, the metric definitions, the dashboards our operations teams run on, and the reporting our enterprise clients see. You will start with our healthcare payments dispute resolution product, which has the largest data footprint and the most immediate reporting need. Once that reporting is running, the role expands across our other products, bringing one set of definitions to metrics that are currently produced product by product. The interesting part of this job is not the dashboards. Much of what our applications display is calculated at read time by application code rather than stored in a column, so the same question can be answered several ways. Your job is to decide what each metric means, document it, prove it reconciles against the systems of record, and defend that definition when someone wants a different number. If you like being the person whose figures nobody argues with, you will like this role. You will work alongside an engineering team of senior fullstack engineers and QA, a product manager, and business leadership in the United States. You will present your numbers directly to executives and to client counterparts, so this is a role for someone comfortable in front of an audience, not only in a query editor. What you will do Build and maintain internal reporting for operational volume, case status and stage, cycle and resolution time, throughput, and service-level metrics. Own payment reconciliation reporting, where the tolerance for an approximate answer is zero. Design and ship scoped, self-service reporting for enterprise clients, so they can answer their own questions without going through our support team. Model data in our analytics warehouse: dimensional models, incremental transformations, and tested, documented pipelines. Own the metric layer. One definition per metric, the query that produces it, the business rule behind it, and a data dictionary anyone can read. Reconcile reporting against the source systems and keep it reconciled as the applications change. Work with role-scoped access and data minimization as a matter of routine. We handle regulated healthcare and payment data, and reporting is built to keep sensitive fields out of it. Improve data quality. Find the defects that make reporting wrong, quantify them, and drive the fixes with the engineering team. Turn ambiguous questions from executives and clients into defined metrics, and say so when a question cannot be answered from the data we hold. Extend the same patterns and definitions to our other products as the function grows. What we are looking for Expert SQL. Complex analytical queries, window functions, and query performance work. You can tell the difference between a number that is surprising and a number that is wrong. Hands-on warehouse experience. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. You have modeled data in one, not only queried someone else’s models. Dimensional and semantic modeling. You have built a reporting layer over a normalized transactional schema and owned the definitions that sat on top of it. Client-facing reporting, shipped. You have built reporting that external customers used, with the scoping and access controls that requires. You write code, not only queries. Production-quality work in Git, code review in both directions, and the ability to build and run your own transformation jobs. Stakeholder judgment. You can sit with an executive or a client, work out what they actually need, and push back when the ask does not hold up. Data governance in a regulated setting. Practical experience with role-based access, handling of personal or health data, and producing evidence for an audit. HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar. Clear written communication. Our team is distributed and most decisions happen in writing. Professional English, written and spoken. You will present to United States executives and to client counterparts. Fluency is required and is assessed in the first conversation. Time zone overlap. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with United States Eastern time, 9:00 to 13:00 ET. Able to contract independently. You can invoice and contract as an independent professional in your country of residence, and accept confidentiality and data-handling terms covering regulated healthcare data. Nice to have Healthcare payments, claims, or payer and provider data. Experience with No Surprises Act dispute resolution is a real advantage. dbt or a comparable transformation framework, in production, with tests. Change data capture pipelines and the failure modes that come with them. Financial reconciliation reporting. Python for data work. Enough TypeScript to read an application and trace how a value is calculated. An embedded analytics or BI tool taken to production with external users, including row-level security. AWS, particularly RDS, S3, and IAM as it applies to data access. Prior work with a United States company in a regulated industry. What this role is not It is not a ticket queue for dashboard requests. You own definitions and you are expected to have opinions about them. It is not platform or infrastructure engineering. We have a platform team and you will partner with them. It is not machine learning or model development. That work sits with a separate team. Tech you will work with TypeScript and Next.js applications, MySQL and PostgreSQL as operational stores, ClickHouse as the analytics warehouse, change data capture between them, Python for data work, and AWS throughout. Our older products run on Python and Flask. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Europe, Remote Hello👋I am Puneet , Co-founder and CPO at Kayzen , and I am now looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃 Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface. The Team You will work with a carefully selected, diverse and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko, Chen) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) . Responsibilities Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including: Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data. Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively. Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain. A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies. You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning: Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions. Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes. Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success. Embrace Experimentation: We believe in the power of experimentation to innovate and refine our approach continually. Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in developing data science products, from initial research through to production deployment. Strong coding skills with a focus on clean, reproducible, and well-tested code. Proficient in key tools and technologies including Python, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Docker, and SQL. Hands-on experience with algorithms for handling sparse and large datasets, including applications in prediction, clustering, and outlier detection. Experience in building neural network-based products for tasks such as classification, regression, and multi-task learning is highly valuable. Bonus skills: Knowledge of reinforcement learning and large-scale optimization problems is a significant asset. Good understanding of dashboards and SQL for developing and enhancing monitoring tools. Previous experience in Ad-Tech is a must. What do we offer? Directly working with Founders and an opportunity to drive direct impact Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Canada, Spain, the UK and many more countries. A flexible work-from-home arrangement Opportunity to relocate to our office in Berlin A 500-dollar home-office setup budget A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Lead Product Analyst, B2C Financial Services
items.summary: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money.
items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today. What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along. About the roleThis role focuses on Tabby Cash , and the growing ecosystem of our debit financial products. You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability , helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics , working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams. You will play a key role in defining how users adopt and use our cards, and how we optimize the products for long-term value. What you will be doing Lead a team of product analysts to provide support to the product and business teams across all aspects of their work. Generate hypotheses, conduct research and A/B tests, and present your findings clearly and compellingly, which highlights the importance of your insights. Regularly work with several stakeholders, including product and marketing teams, on fundamental research as well as on one-time requests. Support and monitor existing metrics for the Financial Products, identify areas for improvement, and develop new metrics that inform decision-making across the organization. Develop data visualizations and reports that are both informative and easily understood by business and product teams. Assist in the planning of necessary data structures and data quality improvements. What you will need Minimum of 4 years of work experience as a data/product analyst. Experience in leading a team of data analysts of any size. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools. Experience in planning data structures for new products and features. Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.) Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus. Experience in leveraging LLM/AI for analytical purposes is a plus. Strong quantitative skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with business and product teams. At least an upper-intermediate level of English proficiency is required. What we offer: Full-time B2B contract Fully remote setup Up to 20% tax allowance 22 paid leave days annually Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed) What you can expect We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals. If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: S’more about the team The position is part of the Growth Alliance, which has the mission to empower the HelloFresh business to convince more customers to try, recommend, or return to our products. Within Growth, the Customer Value Optimization Tribe maximizes long-term customer value by optimizing pricing, personalizing benefits, forecasting customer value (CLV), and creating compelling incentives that drive retention and revenue growth. As a Senior ML Engineer within our Benefits Personalization Squad , you will own the data infrastructure that powers personalized customer experiences at HelloFresh: helping us deliver the right benefits, incentives, and offers to the right customers at the right time. Our Engineers assume development and operational responsibility for the HelloFresh Platform that enables serving millions of customers globally by providing the best & efficient experience for our customers and internal users. Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for Take ownership of the end-to-end process, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operations of data pipelines, applying DevOps practices, pair programming, and other cutting-edge methodologies. Be active, solution-oriented member of autonomous, cross-functional agile teams collaborating with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Owners, Back-end Engineers, Front-end Engineers, Product Analysts, and Business Intelligence teams Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of HelloFresh’s core product and architecture, and act as ambassador for software/data solutions offering support and mentorship to colleagues Work with state-of-the-art technologies like AWS (EMR, Glue, s3, etc), Kafka, PySpark, Kubernetes, Airflow, Prefect, Tecton, Databricks, dbt, as well as our in-house Data Pipeline tools Leverage Claude Code and other AI tools as productivity multipliers All other duties, as assigned Sound a-peeling? Here’s what we’re looking for Experience leading the end-to-end lifecycle of production ML systems, from architectural design to scalable deployment and monitoring. Solid data engineering experience with the ability to design, implement, and deliver maintainable, high-quality code in Python and SQL Hands-on experience with cloud computing and data processing technologies, including PySpark, Kubernetes, Kafka Expertise in data modeling, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), object stores (e.g., AWS S3), data platforms (Databricks) Proven expertise in making efficient and robust data pipelines, including optimizing their performance Passion for leveraging AI tools to streamline collaboration and execution Passion for data quality assurance, data monitoring Expertise in end-to-end development processes, including unit, integration & functional testing, application tuning/profiling, and continuous integration Extensive experience with agile methodologies, with a strong focus on delivery, lean thinking, and quick iterations Ability to continuously develop yourself and learn from your peers Ability to collaborate and mentor team members, while also sharing practical knowledge and trends Familiarity with e-commerce and subscription-based businesses is a plus Interacting with back-end developers, front-end developers, product analysts, product managers and other teams around the world is very much part of our day-to-day, so communication skills are vital. We are looking for strong problem-solvers who can apply their engineering skills to a wide range of platforms and environments, while also acting as an ambassador to coach team members and stakeholders. Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you’ll love it here Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box. Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships! RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance. Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents. Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun! Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts. Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names! Flexible Hybrid Approach At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience. To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week. #LI-HYBRID HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team. This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position. Toronto, ON Pay Range $170,000—$200,000 CAD

items.description: This role owns the software and cloud-native architecture of AI-enabled applications and retrieval systems, from design to production. It combines architectural leadership with hands-on engineering: designing GenAI and RAG solutions, building cloud-native backend services, and ensuring the security, reliability, and observability required for production workloads. Define cloud-native patterns across microservices, containers, serverless, and event-driven systems. Design and productionize GenAI and RAG solutions: model selection and routing, retrieval strategy, evaluation, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization. Build backend services in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python, and event-driven workflows with queues, workers, and webhooks. Define non-functional requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and document decisions in ADRs. Translate business use cases into technical designs, assessments, and executive summaries. Own the architecture from discovery to go-live, guiding engineers through architecture and code reviews. Implement observability and secure CI/CD pipelines. Job requirements 7+ years of software engineering experience. Proven experience owning the architecture of production distributed systems (microservices, domain-driven design, REST and asynchronous APIs). Hands-on delivery of production GenAI or LLM applications, including evaluation and AI safety controls. Experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch, or equivalent). Strong TypeScript/Node.js or Python engineering experience. Deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns: containers and Kubernetes, serverless, event-driven messaging, and resilience patterns. Strong understanding of security in cloud-native systems: identity, authorization, secrets management, and data protection. Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, or CloudWatch). Nice to have AWS: Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB. Conversational and contact center: WhatsApp Business API, Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Twilio, voice bots. Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or equivalent. Customer-facing consulting experience and comfort presenting to executive stakeholders. You are the person who keeps critical operational machinery running smoothly while continuously improving how it works. This role works across the full CX Ops team and partners with stakeholders in TAM, Solutions, Support, Partner Services, Finance, and GTM Systems. You'll collaborate closely with other CX Ops team members on initiatives while taking direct ownership of your assigned processes and analytical deliverables. The right person for this role is detail-oriented, analytically strong, and energized by building automations and AI solutions that eliminate manual work. This role connects directly to our mission of making every CX team faster, better-informed, and more consistent through operational excellence. We are not recruiters, but our work connects hiring strategy to performance outcomes. We work closely…
items.description: Canonical has re-imagined hiring. We have created a Talent Science team that has a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We are not recruiters, but our work connects hiring strategy to performance outcomes. We work closely with our key stakeholders to ensure that decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent. We lead an effective hiring ecosystem to deliver talent acquisition excellence. We leverage data to enable evidence-based decisions, weaving behavioural science throughout our selection process, working closely with our Hiring Leadership team who drive hiring at Canonical. Due to the growth of the business we are seeking a set of new leaders to drive delivery excellence. You will work directly with the Global Head of Talent Science to plan and drive work within the team against our strategic objectives. With overall accountability for project delivery relating to hiring outcomes you will drive efficiencies and create new processes whilst coaching and developing team members to grow their careers. You will bring an analytical and objective approach to work and be seasoned in making data driven decisions relating to talent outcomes. Your experience will include being able to plan and lead project roadmaps, experience interacting with senior leadership on talent related topics leveraging your thought leadership experience and the ability to influence and steer talent agendas internally. You will be capable of stepping up to lead the function when required. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. The role entails Leading and delivering the strategic Talent Science project roadmap using exceptional project management capability and influencing skills to manage multiple projects at any given time. Leveraging expertise from your career to date to design and implement solutions to complex problems that ultimately ensure we hire exceptional talent. Ensuring all talent selection initiatives map to high performance outcomes and career frameworks. Designing professional processes and frameworks, allowing efficient delivery of our agenda. Coaching and mentoring team members to grow and develop skill sets specifically around analytical capabilities and thought leadership, developing training materials and documentation to support team members. Driving and representing the team in the absence of the Head of, acting as a credible and trusted adviser and an inspiring leader. Working closely with company leaders to understand, appreciate and communicate our vision for talent at Canonical. What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a psychology or people based subject. A track record of team leadership in a talent function from the technology or consulting industry, with exceptional project management, to lead roadmap execution and delivery. Deep understanding of talent selection, with a technological mindset to create automation's and products to drive hiring efficiencies. Advanced analytical ability to dissect and analyse data, using either SQL, Python and/or statistical analysis. Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience. Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times a year for company events. Nice-to-have skills Advanced psychometric assessments with an excellent understanding of the marketplace and vendors A deep understanding of human behaviour and what drives intrinsic motivation Experience of using Superset and advanced dashboarding What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

items.summary: ABOUT THE ROLEAs Financial Controller Lead, you will be a strategic finance partner to the executive team, helping drive data-informed decisions that support rapid growth and operational excellence.
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE As Financial Controller Lead, you will be a strategic finance partner to the executive team, helping drive data-informed decisions that support rapid growth and operational excellence. In a fast-paced technology start-up environment, you will own the financial planning and business performance management processes, providing clear insights into revenue, costs, profitability, cash flow, and key business metrics. You will work closely with leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Tech and People to translate complex financial and operational data into actionable recommendations. Beyond traditional financial controlling, you will help build scalable financial processes, improve reporting automation, evaluate strategic investments, and support board reporting, and business expansion initiatives. This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys combining financial rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset and thrives in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and every decision has a measurable impact. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as the primary finance business partner to functional and executive leadership. Lead the company's budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes. Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, new products, pricing decisions, market expansion, and investment opportunities. Monitor and analyze business performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities to improve growth and profitability. Build and maintain executive dashboards and KPIs that measure financial and operational performance. Provide insightful variance analysis and recommend actions to optimize revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and cash flow. Partner with Product, Commercial and Tech teams to evaluate business cases and resource allocation. Support board presentations, and due diligence processes. Drive continuous improvement of financial planning, reporting, and analytics through automation and scalable processes. Collaborate with Accounting to ensure accurate month-end close, financial reporting, and compliance with internal controls. Evaluate SaaS and technology business metrics, including ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, churn, retention, and unit economics, where applicable. Support strategic initiatives, including international expansion, partnerships, M&A, and new business models. Build a culture of financial accountability while enabling fast and informed decision-making across the organization. WHAT YOU BRING Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 7+ years of experience in Business Controlling, FP&A, Strategic Finance, or Corporate Finance, preferably in a high-growth technology company or start-up. Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills. Experience partnering with senior executives and cross-functional leadership teams. Deep understanding of business drivers, or digital business models. Advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities. Fluency using AI tools. Experience with ERP, FP&A, and BI platforms (for example MS Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Workday Adaptive Planning, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar). Excellent analytical thinking with the ability to transform data into strategic business insights. Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence presenting to executives, investors, and board members. Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment with a hands-on approach. Demonstrated ability to build scalable financial processes in a growing organization. Strong project management and stakeholder management skills. High level of ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset. Preferred Qualifications Experience in fintech, blockchain, Web3, digital assets, or cryptocurrency businesses. Understanding of token economics, digital asset accounting, or crypto market dynamics is a plus ROOTIES BENEFITS At RootstockLabs , we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us: Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being. 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces. Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually. Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team. REVIEW ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital. What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money). Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand Originally posted on Himalayas

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the
items.description: Software Engineering Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara, you will be an integral member of the Professional Services Organisation responsible for helping Samsara’s most strategic customers build and implement B2B integrations with our IoT platform. In a given week, you may work with a large long-haul trucking company, an industrial-scale food producer, and a public utility to map a customer’s integration needs to current and future API capabilities, help building custom integrations, provide guidance and technical training to implementation teams to follow best practices, troubleshoot issues and advocate for fixes on behalf of customers (working with our tech support team), and ensure a successful customer relationship. A successful Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of B2B integrations to ensure the proper technical solution is delivered to our customers. Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting product managers, business operations, sales, and systems engineers, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. Since Samsara is a fast-growing company with emerging IoT technology, you can expect this role to evolve, with opportunities to take on increasing levels of responsibility and impact our growth. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. items.title: Vice President, Information Technology
items.summary: For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes.
items.description: For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes. JOB SUMMARY & SCOPE Responsible for the strategic direction, management, and performance of the Company's global technology organization, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, enterprise applications, data management, and IT operations. This position ensures a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology environment that supports a multi-site, acquisition-driven business while leading technology modernization, enterprise integration, IT governance, cybersecurity, vendor management, and M&A integration initiatives. The role serves as the Company's senior authority on information security and IT risk and partners closely with business and technology leaders to align technology platforms, data, and processes with operational and growth objectives. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Develop and execute the enterprise IT strategy, roadmap, and operating model aligned with business objectives. Provide leadership and oversight for all IT functions, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, business applications, data management, and technical support operations. Manage the global technology infrastructure environment, including cloud platforms, networks, telecommunications, endpoints, and site connectivity. Establish standards for system availability, performance, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Lead service desk and technology operations functions, including service management processes, service levels, and operational performance metrics. Direct the enterprise cybersecurity program, including security strategy, governance, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and identity and access management. Serve as the executive leader responsible for information security, technology risk management, and security-related stakeholder communications. Oversee third-party technology risk management, vendor security assessments, and customer security compliance requirements. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, privacy, and security frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and related standards. Maintain the organization's IT risk management framework, audit readiness, internal controls, and compliance reporting processes. Oversee enterprise business applications, including ERP, CRM, productivity, collaboration, cloud, analytics, and workflow management platforms. Drive application integration, process automation, and technology modernization initiatives that improve operational efficiency and data integrity. Partner with executive leadership to establish enterprise data governance, reporting, analytics, and business intelligence strategies. Develop and execute plans to rationalize technology platforms, reduce application redundancy, improve user adoption, and optimize technology investments. Lead IT due diligence, integration planning, and post-acquisition technology integration activities for mergers and acquisitions. Manage the IT operating and capital budgets, ensuring effective financial stewardship, resource allocation, and cost optimization. Direct vendor relationships, contract negotiations, software licensing, and strategic sourcing initiatives. Lead, develop, and mentor IT leaders and teams while communicating technology strategy, risks, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders. EDUCATION + EXPERIENCE + KEY TRAITS Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum of 12 years of progressive enterprise IT experience, including at least 5 years leading multi-functional IT organizations at the Director level or above. Demonstrated expertise leading enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, and IT operations within complex, multi-site organizations. Hands-on experience managing enterprise-scale Microsoft and Azure environments, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies. Experience overseeing enterprise ERP, CRM, data, analytics, and business intelligence platforms, preferably including NetSuite, Salesforce, Azure Data Lake, and Power BI. Proven success developing, implementing, and maintaining cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management programs, including frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR. Demonstrated ownership of significant IT operating and capital budgets, vendor management, contract negotiations, and technology investment strategies. Experience supporting global and multi-country business operations, with strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Preferred experience within private equity-backed, acquisition-oriented, or rapidly growing organizations, including technology due diligence and post-acquisition integration. Experience supporting distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or field service operations and familiarity with enterprise customer security, compliance, and procurement requirements. Knowledge of AI, machine learning, data governance, and advanced analytics environments. Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or similar credentials are preferred. TYPICAL PERFORMANCE TARGETS SERVICE DELIVERY: Sustained, measured excellence in project & process delivery COST TO SERVE: Sustained, measured excellence in delivery efficiency with expected continuous improvement INNOVATION: Step changed delivery in safety, quality, and/or cost LANGUAGE SKILLS Primary language used in daily operations is English. Additional primary company languages include Spanish, French, and Dutch. Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external. Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization. SUPERVISION Responsible for direct and/or indirect reports. DECISION MAKING + REASONING Able to take accountability and responsibility for business target delivery and decision making.
