items.description: Description Anchor closed $40M in top-tier VC funding and grew 500% last year, transforming the $74B services payments market. Our platform automates billing and collections so businesses can focus on growth. At Anchor, we’re redefining the future of B2B Payments. Our innovative, end-to-end billing and collections platform eliminates the frustrations of manual processes, making financial workflows seamless, automated, and stress-free. We empower businesses to focus on their core strengths while we handle the complexities of billing and collections. Our Customer Support organization sits at the core of Anchor and is a key driver for our growth, ensuring every customer has an exceptional experience. As we continue to grow rapidly, we’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Director of Customer Success to build, grow, and lead our customer organization across the entire journey - from onboarding through activation and retention. Reporting directly to the COO of Anchor, the ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional ownership, a holistic business mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and a consultative, action-oriented approach that truly sets them apart. Responsibility Lead and scale Anchor’s Customer Success function across the full customer journey—from onboarding to long-term retention. Develop and execute a comprehensive CS strategy that aligns with customer goals and drives measurable value. Own and evolve onboarding, account management, and customer support processes that maximize adoption and satisfaction. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers—including executive stakeholders—and act as their strategic advisor. Define and track KPIs to measure customer health, satisfaction, and team effectiveness; drive data-informed improvements. Own systems and tooling for customer success (e.g., ticketing, reporting, support infrastructure). Build and maintain a robust knowledge base for internal and customer use. Collaborate closely with product, sales, R&D, and marketing to represent the voice of the customer and shape our roadmap. Develop customer success stories and use cases for both internal learning and external marketing. Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing CS team that delivers excellence at scale. Requirements 2+ years of experience managing CS team leaders, plus 3+ years leading CS teams directly in a fast-paced, data-driven, B2B SaaS company- (Fintech experience is a strong plus.) Building and scaling CS processes from the ground up, along with CS strategies, operating models, and tools, across the full customer lifecycle. Highly detailed and structured professional, with experience designing and implementing scalable CS processes. Superb capabilities in managing even the most challenging customer relationships—able to turn difficult moments into positive, productive outcomes. A highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, prioritize effectively, and adapt quickly. Strong project management chops, you can juggle multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and drive outcomes. Analytical and metrics-driven; you thrive on dashboards, insights, and measurable impact. A true player-coach: you enjoy managing accounts yourself while scaling and supporting your team and processes. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights. Experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across multiple levels of an organization. Skilled in customer meetings, demos, workshops, QBRs, and executive briefings. Proficiency in Excel and CS platforms (e.g., HubSpot) is a must. Bachelor’s degree or MBA in accounting/finance. Or 2+ years of practical managerial experience in those fields- required. And finally: zero ego, we’re a team of builders who work hard, stay humble, and support each other. Extra Experience in management consulting, sales engineering, or post-sales technical support. items.title: Full Stack Data Scientist
items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: ABOUT RENEW CAPITALRenew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries.
items.description: ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities. With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector. Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa. ROLE SUMMARY The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital ’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation. The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions. Responsibilities: The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas: 1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities. Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability. Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses. Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review. 2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls. Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early. Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders. 3. Communication & Insight Generation Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee. Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely. Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred. 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies. Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring. Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes. Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees. Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets. CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes. Location and Travel Opportunities: This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Côte d'Ivoire. About Renew Capital : We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:. Application Process: Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here. Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Further, Renew Capital supports gender-based pay equity and is committed to compensating women and men equally, for equal work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Data and Analytics Job Description: About Us At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Global Business Services Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. Process Overview The CFO India platform provides offshore finance delivery and transformation support to Line of Business (LOB) and Enterprise Finance teams, delivering end to end CFO capabilities across financial accounting and close, financial control and compliance, financial planning and analysis, management and regulatory reporting, financial operations, finance systems, and finance change and ledger modernization initiatives. Data Management team enables the Finance Organization and supports data needs of finance business users The Data Management team is involved in various activities (including, but not limited to): Regulatory Reporting related data management Activities: Team support activities related to US and EMEA Regulatory reports, data validation and resolution of Data quality issues. Team performs a critical role in providing centralized support for Global Banking and Market products (Treasury, Traded, Loans & Deposits etc.) data validation and analysis for internal and external Liquidity reporting. Team is engaged in activities such as validation of data for regulatory reports, data quality issue resolution, data reconciliation with authoritative sources and posting adjustments. Team actively works on strategic initiatives aimed at improving the quality of numbers reported in regulatory reports Data Sourcing and provisioning: This includes defining and implementing data provisioning strategy to source the data from all lines of business into regulatory reports and management reports. Team is actively involved in sourcing initiatives where it works with various source systems, technology teams and report owners to source the data into regulatory reports as per regulator and stakeholder requirements. Job Description This role will be responsible for supporting Data Management - Products team. The primary functions include partnering with data users, upstream data providers, and technology teams to research and drive resolution of data issues, document and communicate new business and data requirements, test data and functionality changes, and develop and maintain controls to ensure the integrity of the data. Additionally, the role is responsible for supporting periodic audits and exams by the internal audit and compliance organizations and various Bank regulatory agencies. Responsibilities Individual will be required to perform following responsibilities (this is an indicative list and could vary depending on business priorities) Work directly with partners in Global Regulatory Reporting, Global Liquidity Management, Enterprise Capital Reporting, etc., to understand their needs and the related market products data implications Ensures data is accurate, complete, and fit for performing data analyses through various testing procedures and data controls which help to identify business insights fit for purpose for a particular product set Continually grow and expand market products and use-case knowledge, with a focus to understand the 'why', to anticipate and proactively address questions and issues before they occur Leverage SQL, Excel, and other analytics tools to identify and understand data issues, quantify impacts, or provide answers to time-sensitive business, audit, and regulator questions Ability to debug SQL/oracle procedures to fix them and also able to write them from scratch as per project requirement Develops, manages, and executes on controls, ensuring tracking, monitoring, and resolution of any control breaches with data platform Constantly evaluate our processes to ensure data risks are identified and properly mitigated, while seeking opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve wherever/whenever possible Data validation & reconciliation: production support, monthly trend analysis or ad hoc analysis Data sourcing, mapping and analysis, reporting Coordinate with business partners, project management team, technology as per requirement in the project Documentation - Provide Inputs on the Project documents etc. Continually identify process improvement opportunities Hands-on experience using Microsoft 365 Copilot or equivalent generative AI tools to accelerate writing, analysis, and presentation of business deliverables Ability to frame effective prompts to generate accurate, relevant, and reusable AI outputs Learning agility and change readiness , with comfort in adapting to new tools, processes, and ways of working, including effective use of AI-enabled tools where relevant Strong collaboration and executive-level communication skills , with the ability to work effectively across teams, functions, and geographies using clear, concise, and professional communication Liaison and Change Build relationships across CFO DM teams including stakeholders e. g. Technology, Treasury, Liquidity to understand and resolve accounting and reporting issues. Support change agenda across group and ensure processes are efficient, consistent, and sustainable, making best use of technology. Supporting DM and enterprise Operational Excellence initiatives Exposure to Emerging technologies like Alteryx, Tableau, UiPath, etc Requirements Education : BE , Btech , MCA , Bsc , BCA , Msc Certification if any : NA Experience Range : 4- 6 years Foundational skills* Advanced SQL experience and understanding of relational databases. Advanced Microsoft Office suite software skills (Excel, Access, Word, SharePoint, One Note, Project) Experience with process automation using tools such as Tableau and Alteryx Significant experience in technology data/risk assessments and remediation efforts. Builds Partnerships - broad-based business relationships across the enterprise. Positively and skillfully influences peers, colleagues, leaders and business partners to collaborate and deliver consistent quality results. Strong organizational ability and extremely detail oriented Excellent written and oral communication skills at all levels (i.e. colleagues to senior management) and situations (i.e. one-on-one to presentations) Dynamic, high energy, solid work ethic, willing to take on new defined and undefined initiatives. Ability to think laterally and identify possible solutions to problems. Self-motivated and independent having an excellent control mindset. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver as well as being able to adapt to changes. Able to work in a fast paced, deadline-oriented environment. High level of ownership and attention to detail Ability to apply sound judgment, provide effective challenge and display confidence to challenge. Ability to self-manage and prioritize, pursue goals and consistently deliver results. Desired skills :- Product Knowledge, SQL, Data Analysis, Regulatory reports knowledge, Tableau Work Timings: 9 hours shift between 11 AM and 11 PM Job Location: Mumbai/GGM

items.description: Software Engineering The opportunity As a Siemens Polarion Architect (ALM) , you will be responsible for defining, designing, and guiding scalable Siemens Polarion ALM solutions that support requirements management, engineering traceability, baselines, change control, verification management, and compliance across HVDC projects. You will act as a key technical authority for Polarion architecture, working closely with engineering, quality, IT, and business stakeholders to translate complex business needs into robust ALM capabilities, governance models, integrations, and long-term platform roadmaps. How You Will Make an Impact Own and define the Siemens Polarion ALM solution architecture to support requirements management, compliance, verification, traceability, and change control across HVDC projects. Design and govern Polarion information models, workflows, work item structures, document templates, baselines, approvals, permissions, and governance frameworks. Provide architectural leadership for Polarion configuration, customization, automation, dashboards, LiveReports, and extensions, ensuring scalability and maintainability. Establish best practices for requirements lifecycle management, end-to-end traceability, test management, defect handling, change impact analysis, and compliance reporting. Design and oversee integrations between Polarion and enterprise tools, including PLM, DevOps, engineering, and test management platforms, using REST APIs, SDKs, and OSLC standards. Drive decisions related to platform performance, scalability, security, access management, data quality, upgrades, and lifecycle governance. Collaborate with engineering, business, IT, and vendor stakeholders to align Polarion capabilities with organizational processes and ALM strategy. Lead solution reviews, continuous improvements, issue resolution, user enablement, and mentoring to promote sustainable Polarion best practices. Your Background Extensive experience with Siemens Polarion ALM in roles such as Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior Configurator, or similar positions within compliance-driven engineering environments. Proven ability to design and implement end-to-end ALM solutions covering requirements, testing, traceability, change management, approvals, reporting, and compliance. Strong knowledge of requirements lifecycle management, including authoring, reviews, baselining, change control, reuse, variants, and traceability. Hands-on experience configuring and customizing Polarion, including workflows, work item types, permissions, dashboards, LiveReports, automation, and reporting solutions. Solid technical skills in Java, JavaScript, Velocity, REST APIs, SDKs, OSLC concepts, and enterprise system integration approaches. Experience defining solution architecture, governance models, data structures, security concepts, release management, upgrade strategies, and configuration standards. Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges and translate business needs into scalable solutions. Excellent communication and documentation skills, with experience creating architecture documentation, technical guidance, training materials, and supporting user adoption; experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Teamcenter, Jira, Git-based platforms, or related ALM/PLM ecosystems is an advantage. items.description: Software Engineering About the team The Industry Software organization builds the B2B SaaS platforms that power Zillow's software and services for real estate professionals, including: - Home listing, lead delivery, and home shopper lifecycle workflows - Identity and access: account hierarchies, user identity, team roster/permissions management - Enterprise integrations: broker rosters, listing feeds, partner data pipelines - Monetization: purchasing, pricing, billing, entitlements, and internal tooling for sales, support, and operations We work in tight partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and Finance to build an integrated, reliable, and scalable B2B ecosystem for our industry customers - and we aim to do it smart, humble, hardworking, and highly collaborative. About the role We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own some of the most complex, strategically important initiatives in Industry Software - multi-team, cross-organizational programs that span multiple product areas, from strategy and scope through execution, launch, and post-launch learning. You'll act as a thought partner to senior and executive leaders, bridge Product, Engineering, and Design to create clarity from ambiguity, and build deep expertise across our domains (monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, real estate SaaS and lead delivery) while operating as a strong generalist who ramps up quickly elsewhere. You'll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: energized by building structure where little exists, balancing technical depth with strong stakeholder management, and setting direction while rolling up your sleeves to get high-quality work done on time. What You'll Do Strategy and planning : Define cross-org initiatives that align with Industry Software and broader Zillow B2B priorities; translate strategy into program charters, success metrics, and multi-release execution plans; shape scope and sequencing with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders. Execution and delivery : Own the program lifecycle end to end - planning, dependency mapping, execution, launch, and post-launch follow-through - and drive the operating rhythms (status reviews, dependency checkpoints, release readiness) that keep teams delivering reliably, without subsuming team-level agile ceremonies owned by EMs and PMs. Risk and metrics : Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early; drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions with leadership; use data to measure program health and guide iterative improvement. Stakeholder communication : Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations; communicate status, risks, and decisions in a crisp, executive-ready narrative up to VP/SVP level. Technical leadership : Build working knowledge of the systems, APIs, and data flows within your program scope; partner with Principal Engineers and architects to shape technical approach; ramp up quickly across domains like monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, and real estate SaaS/lead delivery. TPM craft : Define and refine planning, risk, and reporting best practices for Industry Software; mentor other TPMs as a force multiplier for program management excellence; use AI-native tools to increase program efficiency and decision speed. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $182,100.00 - $290,900.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $173,000.00 - $276,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are 8+ years in Technical Program Management (or equivalent), leading large-scale, multi-team, cross-org programs - including portfolio-level and multi-quarter planning - at mid-size or large companies. Significant experience with B2B SaaS products or platforms , ideally serving business customers with complex account, identity, integration, or monetization needs. Proven track record owning end-to-end delivery of complex, distributed systems or platforms, with strong technical fluency in modern architectures (microservices, event-driven patterns, data pipelines) and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams. Demonstrated ability to build program structure from the ground up: operating rhythms, governance, and metrics for complex initiatives. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive-ready narratives, and proven ability to influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Design, and other partners up to senior and executive leadership. Comfortable applying data-driven prioritization to trade off scope, quality, cost, and schedule across multiple simultaneous programs in a fast-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications Deep experience in one or more Industry Software domains - identity and access, monetization and billing, enterprise integrations, or real estate SaaS and lead delivery - or in adjacent complex B2B platforms (ecommerce, fintech, ad tech), ideally within a platform or internal tools organization where reliability and partner integration are critical. Demonstrated experience mentoring TPMs or shaping TPM best practices within an organization. Familiarity with AI and modern collaboration tooling (program dashboards, automation, document generation) to streamline program management. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. If this sounds like you, we'd love to have you help lead the next chapter of Industry Software at Zillow. Get to know us At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they're most productive-enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company's reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland URL: https://quickmail.com The role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What work looks like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable Every day ⁠Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. ⁠Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. ⁠Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast. and set them up for success. ⁠Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. ⁠Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI ⁠Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. ⁠Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid ⁠Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. ⁠Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week ⁠Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. ⁠Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Requirements Who you are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A plus if you have Have experience with customer facing, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup, . We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How we work together You’ll work directly with me, the founder, and with our lead developer. Working with me can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: My replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something I wrote lands badly or isn’t clear, ask me. My direction can change. I may say one thing, then something different a few days later as I learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. I prefer information to be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if I ask. I can stay frustrated about a problem until it’s solved. That's something I'm aware of and working on. You’ll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. We often think fast and interrupt each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn’t for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn’t take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion we need your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits Contract type (full-time or part-time) Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). Start date: negotiable To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/quickmail-technical-customer-support

Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education. Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards. Responsibilities: Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance; Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment; Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners; Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance; Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms; Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports; Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required; A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required; Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs; Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs; Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot; Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance; Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings; Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement; Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma; Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences; Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus; Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics; Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment; Interest in animal protection issues preferred. This is a full-time remote position based in the United States. Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed. Q ualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status. EOE To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/humane-world-for-animals-web-designer-ecrm-1

You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads. Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code. You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch. AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself. You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team. If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production. Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem. Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads. Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships. Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases. Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships. About You: Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch. You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase. You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need. You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design. You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes. You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce. There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it. Bonus If You: Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences. Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling. Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces. Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway. See the work: AI Gateway AI Gateway documentation Browse AI models AI model leaderboards Design Engineering at Vercel Compensation & Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Disclosures: Privacy: Please review our J ob Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. items.description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A to join our strategic finance organization. This role will report to the Director of FP&A. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will own and be responsible for consolidated planning and reporting deliverables, building and maintaining the company's core financial models, supporting executive- and Board-facing materials, partnering across Strategic Finance pillars to drive the forecast cycle, and continuously raising the bar on the quality and efficiency of our planning infrastructure. You Will: Build, maintain, and fully own components of the consolidated financial model across the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and quarterly forecast cycles Run the forecast cycle end-to-end, and go beyond consolidation to form a point of view: where the plan is at risk, where there is upside, and what leadership should do about it Construct and manage frameworks to evaluate the size, impact, and prioritization of strategic initiatives and capital allocation decisions Own executive-facing financial deliverables, including the Weekly Business Review, monthly OpEx review, and quarterly Board and Audit Committee materials Build clear, decision-ready analyses that explain the "why" behind actuals vs. plan and forecast, at both the consolidated and segment level Partner closely with category, marketing, and ops finance counterparts to consolidate, pressure-test, and synthesize their inputs into a coherent corporate view Regularly build Excel / Google Sheet models from scratch that solve a problem or answer a complex business question Define KPIs, develop scorecards, and build and automate reporting around them Identify and execute opportunities to improve the planning and reporting infrastructure, leveraging AI, automation, and systems to reduce manual effort and elevate analytical quality You Have: B.S. in Finance or Accounting, or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience in roles such as strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, and/or consulting Exceptional financial modeling skills, including building consolidated P&L and scenario models from scratch. The ability to manipulate large datasets is a must. Prior SQL or Looker experience is a plus Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership Strategic thinker who is intellectually curious Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to multitask An ambitious self-starter who thrives in an ever-changing work environment Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. items.description: Associate Director, Merchandise Planning Brilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it. Reporting to the Senior Director of Merchandising, you'll own forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory strategy across every category and function, as well as the roadmap that takes our planning capabilities to the next level. This is a builder's role as much as a planner's: our planning infrastructure is actively evolving, and you'll set the direction, partner with Technology and Merchandising to implement new tools, and raise the analytical bar for the whole team. You'll build planning approaches that work for attribute-based, specification-driven assortments while holding the line on turn, in-stock, and margin. We have a social and environmental mission at the core of our company, and we're looking for someone excited to deliver exceptional business results while helping us advance it. What You'll Do: Inventory Strategy and Forecasting Own sales and inventory forecasts across all categories and functions, and hold the team accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and achievement of inventory plans and KPIs. Set inventory strategy for fine jewelry assortments, including diamond, gemstone, and precious metal commodities, establishing the parameters (weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points) that balance service levels against inventory productivity. Lead inventory planning for new showroom launches and growth initiatives, directing the scenario modeling and statistical analysis that pressure-test those plans. Open-to-Buy and Financial Planning Own and continue to evolve the OTB alignment and consensus process, translating financial plans into actionable buying strategies with Merchandising and Finance. Contribute to the annual bookings, ASP, and margin budget-setting process, bringing the inventory point of view to category and department targets and reporting consistently against inventory KPIs. Planning Systems and Process Create and drive the Inventory Planning roadmap. Work with leadership to initiate, prioritize, and approve projects, and manage long-term program schedules through to adoption. Partner with Technology on planning system implementation and maintenance, leading the broader team’s adoption of new demand planning and reporting tools. Adapt planning tools and models to integrate cleanly with our evolving enterprise systems and reporting, identifying gaps, developing workarounds, and replacing them with durable solutions. Leverage AI tools to automate recurring analysis and reporting, and drive identification and rollout of new AI-enabled planning workflows across the function. Team Leadership and Partnership Manage, coach, and develop a growing planning team through hiring, feedback, and clear team objectives. Raise planning fluency across the organization by mentoring cross-functional Merchandising partners on forecasting and inventory principles, and by representing Planning credibly to executive leadership. What You Bring: 10+ years in merchandise planning, inventory planning, forecasting, or quantitative analysis within retail, product, or e-commerce, including demonstrated success leading and developing a team. Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification a plus. Experience with attribute-based or commodity inventory planning (precious metals, gemstones, or other specification-driven categories) is a strong plus. Expert Excel skills: complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and efficient handling of large datasets. Retail math is second nature. Hands-on experience with demand planning software (Blue Yonder, Logility, Demantra, o9, MI9, or similar) and reporting/BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Power BI); NetSuite or comparable ERP experience a plus. A track record of leading system implementations and cross-functional programs end to end—from defining business requirements and guiding development through adoption—including new forecasting tools, report automation, and process redesign. Experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Excel Copilot, BI-native AI features, Snowflake Intelligence) to automate analysis and reduce manual effort; familiarity with prompt engineering and connecting AI tools to live data sources such as data warehouses or ERP is highly valued. Comfort operating in an evolving systems environment: you can spot the gap, build the workaround, then turn it into lasting process. Expert written and verbal communication, with clear, direct, concise presentations to broader teams and executive leadership. Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter mindset, with the ability to think critically and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. Commitment to respect and inclusion in the workplace. Interest in socially and environmentally responsible organizations and products. What We Offer: Career Growth. We want to see you sparkle! Through regular 1-1’s with your manager, a variety of training opportunities, and an annual 360 review process for all employees, our leaders are dedicated to creating clear pathways for growth. Ask the hiring team for more information on how Brilliant Earth creates a culture of collaboration and growth during your interview conversations! Diverse, mission-minded team. We were founded to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. Learn more about our impact and team diversity Here! Lifestyle Spending Account. At Brilliant Earth , we're committed to your well-being. Enjoy company reimbursements for eligible wellness expenses, such as gym memberships, massage, counseling, and more! Continued Education. Company-sponsored learning in leadership, professional skills, diversity & inclusion, and access to tuition reimbursement for role-specific trainings. Employee Discounts. As an employee at Brilliant Earth , you’ll receive a generous discount on our jewelry. Mental Wellness Perks. We offer access to mental health resources, such as self-care apps and seminars. Our Employee Assistance program offers 24/7 access to counseling! Giving Back and Volunteer Opportunities. In addition to our giving back programs, our teams support local initiatives and spend time together by volunteering. Medical, Dental, and Vision. We offer multiple plans to choose from, including a $0 monthly premium option for employee health insurance and employer HSA contributions. Insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month! 401k match. We know that saving for the future is important. That's why we offer a generous 401k match. Paid Time Off. We know it’s important to recharge and relax Parental Leave. We aim to support our growing families. Employees can utilize our paid parental leave to bond and care for their new additions. Disability and Life insurance. 100% employer-paid. Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits More About Us At Brilliant Earth , our mission is to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. We believe in creating jewelry you can feel good about wearing, without ever compromising between quality and conscience. We are hard-working team players that welcome challenges and rise to any occasion. Our community of collaboration, respect and encouragement is fostered by frequent team events, cross-departmental meetings and celebrating our wins, big and small. As one of the fastest growing e-commerce jewelers in the world, we're searching for bright and passionate people who are excited to make an impact from day one and grow with the company to take on greater responsibility over time. Brilliant Earth recognizes the value of diversity and inclusion on our team, as we work together to reinvent fine jewelry in a thoughtful and modern way. At Brilliant Earth , we celebrate each other – our successes, the lessons along the way, and the unique perspectives each individual brings to our team. It is our intent to maintain a work environment and hiring process which is free of harassment or discrimination because of sex, race, religion, color, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, military service, veteran status, or any other status protected by Federal, State or local laws. We are committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws providing Equal Employment Opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations. When you apply for a job with Brilliant Earth , we process personal information about you. Please see our Privacy Policy for more information.
