items.description: Role Title: Shopify Specialist Role Type: Contract (~5 - 10 hs/week) Location: Remote Required Skills Shopify data model E-commerce analytics Applied Shopify experience Feedback quality In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review proposed Shopify and e-commerce task structures, identifying where they diverge from actual platform workflows and data models. Provide clear, actionable written and verbal feedback on the realism and completeness of analytical scenarios and deliverables. Advise on Shopify's core data objects—including orders, products, customers, and reporting—to ensure analytic tasks align with real-world use. Highlight gaps, edge cases, or unrealistic assumptions in scenario framing, drawing on direct hands-on experience. Recommend improvements to task structures, terminology, and metrics based on best practices in the Shopify and e-commerce ecosystem. Validate that terminology and definitions are consistent with standard Shopify/e-commerce analytics language. Suggest additional cases or refinements to better reflect the operator and analyst perspective. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of deep, hands-on experience within the Shopify ecosystem—across store operations, development, or analytics. Comprehensive knowledge of Shopify's data model (orders, products, customers, reporting). Strong foundation in e-commerce analytics, including conversion, retention, cohort, and revenue measurements. Proven ability to communicate feedback clearly and effectively in both written and verbal forms. Direct experience advising on best practices for structuring Shopify-related analytical work. Experience with multiple Shopify stores, or as a consultant or agency professional (nice to have). Familiarity with Shopify Plus, advanced reporting, and analytical tools such as SQL or BI platforms (e.g., Looker) is a plus. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: US - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Collaborative work management is a $14B category growing at 15% a year, and the enterprise competitive set is consolidating fast. Wrike is hiring a Director of Go-To-Market Operations to lead our global GTM Operations team across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. You will own Wrike’s revenue planning and operational architecture end-to-end driving annual planning, quota setting, territory management, and cross-functional alignment across our global revenue engine. Reporting directly to GTM leadership, you will serve as a strategic co-pilot to executive leaders while leading a hands-on global team of 6–15 operations partners and analysts. This is an action-oriented leadership role for an operational "athlete'' - someone equally comfortable steering C-level strategic decisions, designing enterprise sales workflows, coaching an international team across time zones, and diving deep into the details of compensation plans or GTM forecasting. Your Impact: Global Team Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a global GTM Operations team (15 team members, including embedded business partners and visualization analysts across diverse time zones), fostering a high-performance, team-first culture. Annual Planning & Execution: Lead annual planning, quota allocation, capacity modeling, and territory design across Sales, CS, and Marketing teams. Retention & Growth PMO: Partner with executive leadership to program manage company-wide objectives focused on gross/net retention, bookings, and customer lifecycle optimization. Executive Facilitation: Lead recurring operational cadences with executive stakeholders (Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Legal) to eliminate friction and accelerate deal velocity. Commercial Support & Governance: Oversee non-customer-facing commercial execution, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline order processing and contracting workflows. Your Qualifications: 8+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS. Proven People Leadership: Direct experience managing and developing global operational teams (6+ direct/indirect reports) across international time zones. Core GTM Mechanics: Expertise in SaaS unit economics, quota setting, territory planning, retention/bookings metrics, and annual planning processes. Execution Track Record: High proficiency operating as an executive-level partner to Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership without needing a massive administrative layer. Location Preference: East Coast U.S. preferred (ability to align with global time zones and executive leadership). Standout Qualities: Core Traits: High curiosity (constantly seeking better ways to execute), unyielding commitment to follow-through, and rigorous attention to detail. Sales Methodology: Familiarity with enterprise value selling frameworks (e.g., Force Management's Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, or Challenger). Target Background: Experience operating in high-growth, execution-oriented B2B SaaS environments Team Dynamics: You will partner closely with executive leadership and lead a global team of GTM business partners and data visualization specialists. Your team acts as the central nerve center connecting field execution with executive strategy. Our Work Style: We run Wrike on Wrike. You will use our collaborative work management platform daily to run annual planning, manage operational portfolios, and track team execution. We value intellectual curiosity, data-backed decision-making, and swift cross-functional execution. Benefits & Perks: Flexible Time Off (FTO) Company 401(k) Match Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 2 Volunteer Days Health (medical, dental & vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents) Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped) Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly) $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend Your recruitment buddy will be Aziza Talhi , Senior Recruiter. #LI-AT1 The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process. Total compensation pay range $180,000 — $205,000 USD Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-director-global-gtm-strategy-operations

items.description: At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24 ⁄ 7 , driving both new business and repeat customers. In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business. Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2. Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you’re hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won’t find a better place to learn and accelerate your career. About the Role We’re looking for a SRE Manager to help us build and run infrastructure that just works - even at 3am. You’ll lead a team of engineers who care as much about preventing incidents as they do about resolving them, and you’ll bring a builder’s mindset to reliability: automating toil, sharpening our observability, and increasingly, putting AI to work so humans can focus on the problems that actually need them. This is a role for someone who’s equally comfortable in a 1:1 coaching a direct report and in the middle of a SEV-1 driving toward resolution. What you will be doing: Your Team Coach, mentor, and grow a team of SREs — real career development, not just performance reviews on a calendar Hire and retain strong engineers; build a team people want to stay on Create a culture where blameless postmortems are the norm and people feel safe raising issues early Drive day-to-day project management for the team - running standups, grooming and tracking tickets, and keeping work visible to stakeholders Reliability & Systems Own the availability and performance of production systems end-to-end Set the bar on SLIs/SLOs/SLAs and error budgets - and hold the team (and yourself) to them Run incident management: on-call, escalation, and the postmortems that actually change something afterward Push automation hard so the team spends less time on repetitive firefighting and more on durable fixes Own capacity planning, scaling, and disaster recovery strategy AI-Augmented Operations Put AI investigation/incident agents to work proactively surfacing issues - degraded services, slow endpoints, anomalous error rates - before they page anyone Evaluate and tune AI/LLM-based tooling to cut down false positives and sharpen alerting Bring AI into the incident workflow itself: auto-summarizing incidents, suggesting root cause, drafting the first pass of a postmortem Know where automation should stop and human judgment should take over - and make that call Keep scouting for the next place AI can shave time off MTTR or catch something before a customer does Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with Engineering, Product, and Security to bake reliability into the SDLC from the start, not bolt it on after Be the calm, clear voice coordinating stakeholders during major incidents Represent SRE in architecture reviews and roadmap conversations - and push back when reliability is an afterthought Translate reliability metrics and risk into language leadership can act on Process & Strategy Keep runbooks and playbooks current - not aspirational documents nobody opens during an incident Track the metrics that matter: uptime, MTTR, MTTD, error budgets Drive continuous improvement in monitoring, alerting, and incident tooling Weigh in on budget and vendor decisions for observability and infrastructure What you should have: 8+ years in SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering 2+ years leading or managing a team Deep familiarity with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), plus Kubernetes/Docker Real experience with observability tooling - Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb, ClickHouse Comfort with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) A track record of owning incident management and building a genuine postmortem culture Strong scripting/programming chops (Python, Go, or similar) The ability to explain a gnarly technical problem to someone who doesn’t want the gnarly details What we hope you have: Experience implementing telephony solutions in-house. Chaos engineering experience Managing on-call across distributed or global teams Exposure to security/compliance-adjacent reliability work (SOC2, ISO 27001) A history of scaling an SRE function as a company grows How You Think: Strategic enough to see around corners, hands-on enough to jump in when it matters You own outcomes, especially the messy ones, during an incident You can triage ruthlessly when everything feels urgent You trust data over gut feel, but you know when to override both You lead like you’re on the team, not above it Why you’ll love working here: Podium is the best place to work to: Join the leaders in AI agents — you’ll be building on top of a product already trusted by 60,000+ businesses to run their AI Employee, with a real mandate and real usage to learn from Unlock career-defining growth — this role owns a product area at the center of Podium’s future, with the scope and visibility that comes with it Build with world-class talent — join a team of engineers who ship fast, use AI tooling seriously, and care as much about outcomes as elegance Make a real impact on local business — the agents you build directly help local businesses respond faster, convert more leads, and grow revenue without adding headcount Benefits: Open and transparent culture Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage Paid maternity and paternity leave Fertility Benefits Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits 401k Plan with company matching Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

items.title: Senior Manager, CPG Customer Success at Instacart
items.summary: We’re transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. items.description: We’re transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu Join Instacart Insights as a Senior Manager of Customer Success. We are searching for an experienced CS leader with deep CPG and retail expertise to drive customer value delivery and satisfaction with Instacart Insights’ pioneering SaaS solutions. As a senior leader within the Customer Success organization, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of our commercial organization. You will oversee a team of Managers and Customer Success Managers focused on CPG brands of all sizes, coaching them through the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and micro-testing to data-driven insights and scaled rollout of optimal topline revenue strategies. This is an opportunity to shape how a world-class Customer Success team operates while experiencing first-hand the excitement of introducing novel, demonstrably superior capabilities to transform the market. What you’ll cook up in your first year Lead, hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Customer Success professionals, driving team performance and customer satisfaction across the portfolio while embodying our “Serve Generously” value. Drive that performance through clear metrics, regular coaching, strategic planning, and a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Shape the future Customer Success organization as it rapidly scales. Partner closely with the Director, CS and cross-functional leaders to standardize processes, build playbooks, and establish best practices across the broader organization. Oversee the end-to-end customer journey from onboarding to full adoption. Guide your team in analyzing and synthesizing test results, delivering data-driven insights that influence customer strategies, and help customers through the organizational and process changes required to integrate topline revenue insights into their at-shelf strategies at scale. Manage key customer relationships as a senior point of contact for a portfolio of complex, multi-stakeholder accounts, driving engagement and satisfaction with our SaaS solutions, successful renewals, and business expansions. Foster cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Product, Marketing, Enablement and Pre-Sales teams to align customer engagement strategies. Act as the internal voice of the customer, synthesizing feedback for Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to inform roadmap decisions, and identify trends across accounts to drive strategic decisions for the broader organization. The secret ingredients we’re looking for Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 12+ years of work experience with 5+ years of team leadership experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with demonstrated success in customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction Proven track record of building, scaling, and managing high-performing Customer Success teams in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder customer relationships with consistently high satisfaction and renewal rates Deep expertise in CPG and/or Retail verticals, including a strong understanding of trade promotion, consumer insights, and merchandising dynamics Demonstrated ability to translate complex customer needs into actionable strategies for your team and the broader organization Strong analytical background, including data analysis and synthesis into compelling presentations and executive-level narratives Experience developing business processes and best practices in fast-paced, high-growth environments Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior executives and multi-stakeholder audiences Demonstrated ability to motivate clients and internal teams through process or organizational change Willingness to travel up to 40% Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) Experience with CPG SaaS solutions, particularly in consumer insights, promotional strategy, or retail execution technologies Proven track record of adapting to and driving innovation in rapidly evolving technological landscapes Proficiency with data visualization tools and CRM systems Experience analyzing and improving CS performance metrics including NRR, retention rates, and time-to-value Experience managing remote or distributed teams At Instacart, we believe in “Rolling Up Your Sleeves” and “Putting it All on the Table.” As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you’ll have the opportunity to directly shape our Customer Success organization while driving meaningful outcomes for our customers. If you’re ready to grow your career while helping grow the pie for everyone in our ecosystem, we want to hear from you! #LI-Remote Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. This role also includes a Sales Incentive Plan. The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance. Payout terms will be based on the Sales incentive Plan for this role. OTE range for this role is listed below and is based on salary and fixed paymix for the role. Sales incentive pay is contingent on performance and paid in accordance with the terms of the applicable Sales Incentive Plan Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. WA $170,000—$179,500 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $163,000—$172,000 USD All other states $148,000—$156,000 USD CA, NY, CT, NJ $177,000—$187,000 USD OTE Range $211,000—$267,500 USD

items.description: About Trafilea Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands. With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands. We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint. Why Trafilea We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast. 🚀 We build and scale our own brands. 🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom. 📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same. 🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team. 🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more. Job Responsibilities At Trafilea , demand planning isn’t about reacting to numbers — it’s about engineering the system that drives millions in Amazon revenue. You’ll own the engine behind our Retail Stores / Beauty operation: forecasting, replenishment, automation, and inventory performance across FBA and 3PL. This is where data, operations, and growth collide. You won’t just “plan demand.” You’ll build the infrastructure that makes it scalable. Design SKU-level demand forecasts across Amazon marketplaces Build automated replenishment systems between 3PL and FBA Maintain 60+ days coverage at FBA while optimizing stock across the pipeline Improve forecast accuracy (MAPE) and eliminate stockouts & excess inventory Lead automation projects (alerts, triggers, dashboards) with BI & Tech teams Turn Amazon data into real-time decisions that impact revenue and profitability Requirements 3+ years in demand planning (e-commerce or CPG), ideally with Retail Stores / Beauty Strong experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA operations Advanced Excel skills (modeling, forecasting, data analysis) Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Redash, or similar) Analytical, structured thinker with strong attention to detail Builder mindset: you automate, optimize, and improve everything you touch Comfortable managing multiple SKUs, reports, and priorities simultaneously Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Research Manager - Animal Welfare
items.summary: About the roleRethink Priorities' Animal Welfare Department produces research and strategic advice to help organizations make well-informed decisions for animals.
items.description: About the role Rethink Priorities ' Animal Welfare Department produces research and strategic advice to help organizations make well-informed decisions for animals . The Department is splitting into three teams. The AI and Animals Team helps organisations navigate an AI-transforming world. The Frontiers Team advances the field of animal welfare, focusing on neglected animals (such as shrimp) and emerging topics (such as breeding for welfare). And a new Animal Welfare Strategy Team, described below. The Animal Welfare Strategy Team (working name) will focus on supporting and accelerating funders and organizations toward achieving their core goals of accelerating the end of low-welfare farming and reducing the suffering of animals on farms , with a focus on terrestrial vertebrates. This will involve a mix of consulting work, in-house research, and other activities. Recent consulting work has included economic analysis of egg prices for a policy advocacy organization, prioritization of welfare-tech ideas for a venture studio, and research on alternative-protein regulation to guide a large grantmaker with a $10m+ portfolio. RP is independent: clients get the answers that the evidence supports, whether or not they are the ones they hoped for. In-house research might involve building data tools and resources to map where animals are suffering on farms, or strategic analysis to guide stakeholders' decisions. The team will also run the annual Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum, which brings together leaders from across the animal welfare landscape. Going forward, it may build capacity for other actions to enable the success for existing and new projects, such as regranting or talent programs. The department seeks to hire a Senior Research Manager to lead this new Animal Welfare Strategy Team . This is a leadership role in a Department that is growing and being restructured. You will need to work with the Director to set a strategy for this team covering how the team prioritizes projects, and how the team measures and maximizes impact for the animals. We are looking for someone excited to build these structures. You will also work on hiring, managing incoming consulting projects, designing research processes, and managing staff. We want to create a team with a mix of cross-cutting skills, such as economics, policy, animal welfare ecosystem knowledge, stakeholder management, M&E, and animal science. We have 1–2 economist staff ready to join this team. This role will report to Sam Hilton, Acting Director of the Animal Welfare Department. Ideal start date: Monday 4th January 2027 Key Responsibilities You are responsible for leading the team's areas of work. This includes: Manage consulting intake . Decide which requests from funders, advocacy organizations, and entrepreneurs RP takes on, reshapes, or declines. Identify opportunities and act on them . Bring forward ideas with outsized upside, research or otherwise. For research, set an agenda of priority projects. For other interventions, such as regranting or talent programs, decide whether RP should run them and launch what clears the bar. Oversee the Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum . Ensure your team: sets the agenda, decides who is in the room, and turns the movement's annual leaders' gathering into decisions and impact. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Set strategy. Decide how this team prioritizes, how it measures impact and what work it takes on. There is no project prioritization process, impact framework or intake system yet – you will build them alongside the Director. Hire . Decide which skills the team needs next: policy, M&E, animal science, movement experience. Run the rounds, supported by RP's in-house recruitment specialist. Manage the team . Lead economists and specialists with deeper expertise than yours in their own fields. Set the quality bar. Put in place research processes, review standards and project tracking. Deliver research that gets used . Scope clients' decisions, manage staff to deliver on deadline, and follow up on whether clients acted on the findings. Represent RP . Build the networks and relationships that generate new projects. Attend conferences where you are able to travel. Fundraise . With the Development Team's support, raise additional funds as the team grows. What We Are Looking For Essential criteria Impact first. Driven to have as much impact for animals as possible. Committed to integrity in research, to following the evidence, and to being transparent about what it shows. Decision-oriented research experience. Experience conducting or overseeing research aimed at informing or influencing a specific stakeholder's decision. Good judgment. Demonstrated judgment in prioritization and decision-making under uncertainty. Management experience. Experience managing or mentoring others, including people with deeper expertise than yours, or clear readiness to step into a people-management role. Strategy and process design. Experience of, or clear ability to set a team's strategy and build processes to deliver it where none existed. Research review skills. Ability to interrogate both qualitative and quantitative analysis you did not produce, and to "think at the margin" about cost-effectiveness. Communication skills. Excellent reasoning transparency: ability to show the assumptions and evidence behind your conclusions. Strong ability to synthesize complex information and communicate strategic insight in writing and in person. Delivery. Track record of getting projects finished, on deadline, involving other people. Works well and makes autonomous decisions in a remote, asynchronous, international environment. Desirable criteria Consulting experience. Consulting or other client-facing analytical work: identifying the decision a client is actually facing, shaping or declining work accordingly, and building relationships with clients and fundraising leads. Experience of the animal organizational landscape . Professional or voluntary experience of animal advocacy. A working knowledge of the organizational landscape, funders, and strategic debates. In-depth expertise in a relevant area. Such as economics, policy and regulation, M&E, or animal science. Events and convening experience. Running convenings or facilitating events that bring together groups with differing interests. Talent development experience. Running talent programs or fellowships. Grantmaking experience. Distributing funds and evaluating organizations for funding. We expect that even highly qualified applicants will not meet all of these criteria. We encourage you to apply even if you do not have some of these skills, knowledge and experiences. What We Offer Compensation We offer an annual salary within the following ranges for a full-time position, prorated for part-time work: $98,500 - $125,000 USD pre-tax £76,590 - £97,176 GBP pre-tax €89,459 - €113,527 EUR pre-tax Compensation is not restricted to the currencies listed above. The exact salary will be based on the candidate’s title level, and calculated using RP’s salary algorithm. Towards the upper end we would expect a track record of leading a research team to drive impact. Towards the lower end we would expect strong research judgment with a shorter management record, or management experience but weaker research skills. You do not need to say which end you think you fit; we assess this from your application. To ensure fairness across the entire organization, RP does not negotiate salaries. Other Benefits Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, high-impact organization — our research is used by key decision-makers who influence the distribution of hundreds of millions of charitable dollars. Remote-first environment, including flexible work hours and schedule. Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group Comprehensive global benefits program, including statutory benefits as required by local law, and supplemental benefits specific to each country (varies by location) Generous paid time off (PTO) and unpaid leave, including: Unlimited vacation with a minimum number of required statutory days off "Mandated" 3 weeks total mid- and end-year organization-wide breaks Unlimited (within reason) personal and sick paid and unpaid leave Parental leave — at least 4 - 9 months of a combination of paid and unpaid leave, available prior to and/or during the first 2 years after a child's birth or adoption Other paid and unpaid leave (e.g., bereavement) Technology stipend of $2,000 USD equivalent every 3 years for work and office equipment and an AI tools budget of $40 USD equivalent monthly Professional Development Budget of $4000 USD per year. Learning opportunities, including workshops/training sessions and up to 10% of work time dedicated to professional and personal development Paid work trips, including one annual all-staff Mega Team Retreat and relevant conferences A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance. Low administrative bureaucracy. We don’t provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want! Apply here Application deadline Mon 19th October , end of day (anywhere on earth). Please click the link on the sidebar / at the foot of this page to apply. Additional Information Role-Specific Work Environment and Visa Sponsorship: This role is fully remote and we are able to legally hire in many countries. In certain cases, we may be able to provide visa sponsorship to the US or UK and help candidates relocate. If you have questions about whether we can hire or provide visa sponsorship in another country and if this will influence your decision about applying, please contact before submitting your application. Time Zones and Working Hours: While we welcome applicants from all time zones, you will need to have some availability for meetings between 3pm and 5pm UK time on most weekdays, when our Europe-based and US Central time based colleagues overlap. Depending on where you are, this may mean early morning or evening calls. Full and Part Time Position: This role is open to full-time and part-time candidates who are available to work at least 24 hours per week. Candidates able to work at least 30 hours a week will be preferred. Travel: Travel is not an essential requirement for this position. Travel is not mandatory, but encouraged. A majority of our staff travel a few times per year for conferences, team and all-staff retreats, and other work-related purposes. If, for any reason, you would prefer not to travel for work, please do not be discouraged from applying. Depending on the event, we can likely make accommodations, such as allowing virtual participation when possible. Language: Professional level of English language is required for all roles at Rethink Priorities . Application process There are 4 evaluation stages. Only candidates who meet the minimum bar at a given stage will proceed to the next stage. We aim to complete assessments for each stage within a week, so you can quickly learn whether you will proceed to the next stage. Stage 1: Application Prompts We will score whether your responses to the prompts indicate: alignment with our mission ability to perform tasks that are common for the role relevant experience in similar roles Stage 2: Skills assessment You will complete a ~5-hour task that assesses core competencies for the role. You will be paid $45 USD per hour for completing this assessment Stage 3: Interviews We will ask you questions relevant to a variety of skills and experiences required for the role. Most of these questions will be sent in advance. In a few cases, we will tell you about the topic in advance, but not the specific question. You will have an opportunity to ask questions about the role, the Animal Welfare department, and RP more broadly. Stage 4: Reference checks and offers We will ask for two to three references about your job experiences. Hiring Process-Specific Anonymity : We initially assess on anonymized application prompts and test tasks. Please do not send a cover letter, and do not include your name in your responses to the longer application prompts. Extension requests: We will try to accommodate extension requests made before the deadline, up to 3 days. We generally cannot accommodate extension requests made after the application deadline, or that are longer than 3 days, and cannot accept late submissions to ensure fairness to other applicants. AI use in initial application: You may search for information online or use a free AI assistant (such as ChatGPT, free tier) to provide you with additional support in responding to the initial application questions. If you use an AI assistant, please disclose how you used it and how it changed your responses. Application materials: All application materials must be submitted in English language; otherwise, we will not be able to evaluate your candidacy. Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. Please don’t hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. We provide reasonable accommodations and benefits, including, for example, flexible work schedules and locations, mental health coverage through medical benefits (as available), as well as technology budgets and professional development time that can be used, for example, to purchase assistive technology or engage in job coaching. Accessibility: We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible hiring process. We warmly invite you to reach out to with any questions or accessibility requests such as chat box use during interviews. Hiring Software: We use Pinpoint for our recruitment and hiring processes and all of the email correspondence is done via Pinpoint. We encourage you to add Pinpoint domain (@pinpoint.email) to your trusted contacts and/or check your 'spam', 'promotions' and ‘updates’ folders, if you don’t hear from us within the expected timeframe. Past applicant policy: We may be able to accelerate your job application if you have applied to the same or similar role within RP or a similar institution and advanced within the last 2 years. Please get in touch stating which role you applied to, when, and to which stage you were advanced at which organization if you would like to be considered for this possibility. Consideration for other roles : We sometimes identify strong candidates in one hiring round whose skills are well matched to other senior roles within the department. If you are not selected for this position, we may contact you to ask whether you would like to be considered for a related senior opening, should one arise. You do not need to indicate interest at the application stage. Other: Visit our Career webpage if you’d like to know more about our hiring process, culture, and what working at RP is like. About Rethink Priorities Founded in 2018, Rethink Priorities (RP) is a think-and-do tank. Through research and action, the organization improves the lives of humans and animals—both now and in the future. We work to identify solutions, mobilize resources, and empower our team and others to address some of the world’s most pressing problems. Our team conducts rigorous research across animal welfare, climate change, global health, international development, and other important and neglected areas. Our operations experts help high-impact organizations to improve efficiency and achieve meaningful results. RP works as all of the following: A consultancy doing commissioned work in response to demands from organizations doing high-impact work A research institute driven by research agendas we set according to our own priorities. A think tank aiming to inform public policy to improve the world. An accelerator, incubator, and base for priority projects. Accomplishments include: Bringing attention to neglected issues, such as lead exposure, fungal diseases, and shrimp welfare. Increasing the collective impact of advocates across each field in which we work through strategic coordination. Investigating potential interventions and identifying the most cost-effective options. In 2025, our research influenced tens of millions of dollars in foundation grants. Creating practical tools for philanthropists to compare resource allocations across different species and cause areas and to build giving portfolios despite uncertainties. Providing organizations with data to inform their decisions. For example, we have conducted surveys on perceptions of existential risks, AI, effective giving, and other topics. Providing fiscal sponsorship and operational support to ensure that high-impact initiatives in areas like AI safety and animal welfare can launch and grow effectively. Donor Compass - Cross Cause Fund Tool to guide philanthropic giving We welcome you to review our research database and our latest annual report. Contact Contact: Please email if you have any questions. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Chief Operating Officer
items.summary: About Fòs FeministaFòs Feminista is a global intersectional feminist organization advancing the sexual and reproductive health and rights of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
items.description: About Fòs Feminista Fòs Feminista is a global intersectional feminist organization advancing the sexual and reproductive health and rights of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. Led and governed by the Global South, Fòs Feminista works through a constellation of affiliated organizations, legal entities, strategic partnerships, and movement relationships with around 200 civil society partners across 40 countries. Our work integrates advocacy, grantmaking, research, movement-building, sexual and reproductive healthcare, and innovative finance to strengthen feminist organizations and movements worldwide. Operating across multiple jurisdictions and institutional structures, Fòs Feminista brings together legal, political, philanthropic, and movement strategies to advance gender justice and achieve lasting systemic change. Position overview Fòs Feminista is seeking a Chief Operating Officer to provide strategic and operational leadership across the organization. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving on the Strategic Management Team (SMT), the COO will translate strategy into coordinated plans, sound resource decisions, effective institutional systems, and accountable implementation. The COO will integrate People, Inclusion, and Culture; Business Intelligence, Evaluation and Research; and Legal Affairs. The Chief Financial Officer will report to the COO for operational integration and fiduciary responsibilities while retaining a direct relationship with the CEO. The role requires a leader who can move between strategy and execution and work across functions, regions, and cultures. Position within the organization Reports to: Chief Executive Officer Leadership body: Strategic Management Team Direct and functional oversight: • People, Inclusion, and Culture Business Intelligence, Evaluation and Research • Legal Affairs • Chief Financial Officer, within the dual-reporting arrangement described above Principal responsibilities 1. Executive leadership and strategic execution • Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and an active member of the SMT, contributing to the development, review, and implementation of organizational strategy. • Translate priorities into annual and multi-year plans that connect responsibilities, timelines, resources, and measures of progress. • Help SMT assess opportunities and challenges in relation to mission impact, finances, organizational capacity, risk, and effects on partners; monitor progress and address barriers. • Support organizational continuity, assume responsibilities delegated by the CEO, and represent Fòs Feminista with the Board, partners, donors, advisers, and other external actors as appropriate. 2. Organizational integration and performance • Act as a principal integrator across strategy, finance, people, evidence, legal affairs, resource mobilization, and operational capacity. • Strengthen cross-unit planning, clarify responsibilities and decision points, and ensure that organizational gaps and matters without a clear institutional owner are addressed. • Lead policy development, integrated systems implementation, the responsible use of AI, and major organizational change to improve efficiency and cost-effectiveness. 3. Financial stewardship and organizational sustainability • Provide executive oversight of financial planning and performance with the CFO and CEO, connecting budgets, forecasts, staffing, fundraising projections, program commitments, and organizational priorities. • Support budgets, financial scenarios, and resource-allocation recommendations; monitor performance, sustainability, and risks; and ensure that SMT receives timely analysis. • Ensure strong systems for financial controls, restricted funding, grants and contracts, audits, procurement, and compliance while protecting the CFO’s professional and fiduciary responsibilities, including direct access to the CEO and, where appropriate, the Board. 4. Connection with resource mobilization Align revenue strategies and major proposals with organizational priorities, delivery capacity, financial forecasts, commitments to partners, realistic costing, and risk analysis. • Strengthen coordination throughout the funding cycle; support governance and performance monitoring of the Feminist Impact Fund; and assess the funding portfolio’s effect on longer-term sustainability. • Join selected donor discussions when institutional, financial, or operational questions require executive participation. Fundraising strategy, donor cultivation, and revenue generation remain with Resource Mobilization and the CEO. 5. People, inclusion, and culture Provide strategic leadership to People, Inclusion, and Culture and ensure that recruitment, performance, compensation, development, succession, and staff well-being support the mission and strategy. • Strengthen management practice, organizational design, workforce planning, accountability, and team development while sustaining trust and collaboration. • Ensure that people practices reflect feminist values, equity and inclusion, and a distributed multilingual workforce, and that difficult matters can be addressed with clarity, fairness, and appropriate confidentiality. 6. Business intelligence, evidence, and organizational learning • Provide strategic oversight to Business Intelligence, Evaluation and Research; strengthen the use of data in planning and decisions; and ensure that reporting and indicators serve learning and accountability. • Ensure appropriate governance, protection, and ethical use of organizational and partner data. Oversee and integrate staff safety, digital and information security, AI risks, and crisis response. 7. Legal affairs, compliance, and risk Provide executive oversight of Legal Affairs and ensure that legal considerations enter organizational planning and decisions early. • Maintain an organization-wide approach to legal, financial, operational, safeguarding, security, data, reputational, and people-related risks, including appropriate controls, escalation, continuity arrangements, and responses to significant compliance matters. • Ensure that contractual, regulatory, and governance obligations across jurisdictions are understood and managed. • Protect the professional independence of Legal Affairs. Its head retains direct access to the CEO and, when required, the appropriate Board body, including for concerns involving any senior manager or the COO. Decision-making and authority The COO will exercise authority delegated by the CEO and established through organizational policies, approved plans, and governance responsibilities. Decisions with significant strategic, financial, legal, reputational, workforce, or partner implications will be brought to the CEO, SMT, or Board. The COO will support them with integrated analysis, clear options, and effective implementation. Leadership profile The successful candidate will be a senior organizational leader with the judgment, experience, and relational capacity to work across multiple functions and institutional contexts. They will combine strategic perspective with disciplined execution and lead through coordination, trust, and influence as well as formal reporting relationships. They will bring: Demonstrated experience in a senior executive or enterprise-wide role in a complex international nonprofit, philanthropic, social-impact, or other mission-driven organization. • Experience leading or integrating several functions, such as finance, people and culture, operations, legal or compliance, organizational data, strategy implementation, or business development. • Strong financial literacy and experience using budgets, forecasts, and analysis to guide decisions and connect strategy with measurable results. • Experience working across countries, cultures, legal environments, or distributed teams and building productive relationships with senior colleagues, boards, staff, partners, donors, and advisers. • Experience leading change, strengthening systems without unnecessary bureaucracy, supporting functional leaders, and fostering collective accountability, with excellent judgment in sensitive matters. • A clear commitment to feminist principles, sexual and reproductive health and rights, racial and gender justice, and leadership from the Global South. • An understanding of partnership-based organizations and systems responsive to partner priorities. Professional fluency in English is required; Spanish, Portuguese, or French is an asset. No single professional pathway is required. Candidates may come from operations, finance, organizational strategy, people and culture, international nonprofit management, philanthropy, social enterprise, or another relevant field, provided they demonstrate the breadth required for enterprise-level leadership. Personal and leadership qualities The COO should be: Strategically minded and attentive to implementation, able to move between organizational detail and long-term questions and create clarity in ambiguous situations. • Collaborative but prepared to make difficult decisions, hold colleagues accountable, respect their expertise, and listen across differences. • Transparent, reliable, calm under pressure, and committed to shared leadership, sound delegation, and collective governance. Indicators of success During the initial period, success in the role would include: Clearer integration among Finance; People, Inclusion, and Culture; Business Intelligence; Legal Affairs; Resource Mobilization; and other units. • Greater consistency among strategy, budgets, staffing, fundraising commitments, operational capacity, and organizational evidence. • Clear and trusted planning, follow-through, decision-making, and escalation processes, with stronger support for managers. • Effective management of institutional risk through systems that remain proportionate and responsive to partners. • A trusted working relationship among the CEO, COO, CFO, SMT, and Board, and a leadership culture combining accountability with feminist values. Location: This position is fully remote. Compensation: Fòs Feminista offers generous compensation consistent with competitive salaries and a benefits package that includes private health coverage, life insurance, retirement benefits, paid sick, vacation leave and parental leave, holidays, and flexible working arrangements. The annual salary is up to USD up to $220,000. Safeguarding Commitments Fòs Feminista is committed to ensuring that the health, rights and wellbeing of all children, young people, and vulnerable populations who work and engage with Fòs Feminista ’s Team Members and Associated Persons are respected and protected in their interactions with them and requires all its Team Members and Associated Persons to share this commitment. The successful candidate must: • Demonstrate an understanding of and commitment to safeguarding in the United States and the international context. • Sign and adhere to Fòs Feminista ’s International Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct, including the minimum operating standards for protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA). Equal Opportunity Employer Statement Fòs Feminista is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to advancing sexual and reproductive rights and health and dismantling inequities from a feminist intersectional lens. Reproductive justice, racial justice, and diversity are driving forces for us. Fòs Feminista provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, race, color, disability, national origin, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital and partnership status, genetic information, veteran status or any other protected category under federal, state and local law. At Fòs Feminista , we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices and experiences of our employees. We strongly encourage applications from all kinds of backgrounds to build a diverse workforce in which all social and minority groups are represented. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Software Engineering Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Our office is in Bengaluru, but we offer flexibility for eligible candidates to work remotely across India. Whatever your preferenceworking from home, an office, or in between you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We're looking for a Principal Backend Software Engineer to join our team, passionately focused on delivering creative improvements for our engineering teams. Your future team To be a 100-year company, we are proudly building a world-class engineering organization composed of empowered teams that are equipped with the tools and infrastructure to do the best work of their careers. Engineering at Atlassian prioritizes initiatives that advance AI and support our customers' transition to the cloud while consistently delivering maximum value through our core product suite - Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Bitbucket. We seek individuals who are eager to shape the future and believe in the power of collaboration to achieve extraordinary results together. In this role, you'll get the chance to: Regularly tackle the largest and most complex problems on the team, from technical design to launch Deliver solutions that are used by other teams and products Determine plans-of-attack on large projects Routinely tackle complex architecture challenges and apply architectural standards and start using them on new projects Lead code reviews & documentation as well as take on complex bug fixes, especially on high-risk problems Set the standard for thorough, meaningful code reviews Partner across engineering teams to take on company-wide initiatives spanning multiple projects Transfer your depth of knowledge from your current language to excel as a Software Engineer Mentor more junior members of the team At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. Your background: 12+ years experience in multiple hands-on software/technology leadership roles, with end-to-end responsibility through the software development lifecycle. Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience). Expertise with one or more prominent languages such as Java, Python, Kotlin, Go, or Scala is required. Understanding of SaaS, PaaS, IaaS industry with hands-on experience with public cloud offerings (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure). Knowledge to evaluate trade-offs between correctness, robustness, performance, space and time. Practice in mentoring other engineers and influencing decision makers throughout the organization. Considers the customer impact when making technical decisions. Experience in Developer Experience or Developer Productivity. Proficiency in Java or NodeJS. Experience in at least one additional language. Experience in CI (Continuous Integration) and CD (Continuous Deployment) Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . About Atlassian At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh . In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Denmark URL: https://baymard.com/ We’re seeking a full-time, remote Market Research Data Analyst for our company. Baymard Institute conducts large-scale UX research studies, sharing our findings through a bespoke B2B SaaS platform that serves 2,000+ retailer stores, brands, and agencies across 80+ countries — including 71% of Fortune 500 e-commerce companies. We’re fully distributed, with ~60 team members spanning America and Europe, all committed to advancing ecommerce UX. What You’ll Do As our Market Research Data Analyst, you’ll own quantitative survey studies from initial research and questionnaire design through fieldwork, analysis, and publication. Our Quant Insights team conducts recurring studies examining how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products and services online across different industries and focused topics. A typical study takes approximately three months from beginning to end. Once one study is completed, you’ll begin the research cycle again in another industry or topic area. This means the role combines variety in subject matter with consistency in research methodology . You might spend one study investigating how consumers shop for electronics and the next examining how they book flights, while following a similar end-to-end research process each time. However, a significant part of this role involves repeatedly executing and improving a structured research process . At the same time, the process itself is not fixed . Our Quant Insights team is relatively new, and our research program continues to evolve. Team members are encouraged to challenge existing approaches, experiment with better methods, improve our tooling and workflows, and propose changes to how studies are designed or executed. If you identify a better way to design a questionnaire, analyze our data, automate part of the workflow, structure a study, or even rethink part of our research process, we want you to make the case for it and help us improve it. Your responsibilities will include: Research & Survey Design Conducting desk research to understand an industry, its consumers, and the ecommerce experiences we want to investigate. Translating research objectives into clear, testable research questions. Designing questionnaires, including question wording, response scales, survey structure, branching, and screening criteria. Identifying appropriate respondent audiences, quotas, and sample requirements. Reviewing pilot results and refining questionnaires before full fielding. Considering potential sources of survey bias, measurement error, and data-quality issues throughout the research process. Survey & Fieldwork Execution Programming and QA’ing surveys (we use Alchemer), including logic, quotas, branching, and redirects. Coordinating with sample providers on feasibility, targeting, and setup (we use PureSpectrum). Monitoring soft launches and active fieldwork. Evaluating incoming responses for data-quality issues and determining appropriate cleaning or exclusion criteria. Troubleshooting issues independently. Data Analysis & Synthesis Cleaning, structuring, and analyzing survey datasets. Conducting descriptive and comparative analyses across questions and respondent segments. Exploring relationships and meaningful differences within the data while avoiding overinterpretation of results. Identifying the most meaningful findings from large survey datasets rather than simply reporting every result. Synthesizing findings across multiple questions to develop broader insights into consumer behavior. Creating charts and writing analysis takeaways that communicate findings clearly. Translating quantitative findings into concise, evidence-based insights relevant to ecommerce UX professionals and decision-makers. Your role may gradually expand to include new or more complex studies, program management, or strategic initiatives, depending on your interests and Baymard’s needs. Your Daily Tasks While your exact workload will vary depending on where your current study is in its lifecycle, most of your time will involve activities such as: Researching consumer behavior within an industry. Designing and refining survey questions. Programming and QA’ing surveys. Reviewing pilot data and determining what should change before launch. Coordinating sampling and monitoring fieldwork. Cleaning and preparing survey datasets. Analyzing overall results and meaningful respondent segments. Investigating interesting or unexpected patterns in the data. Determining which findings are meaningful enough to publish. Creating charts and synthesizing findings into clearly written research insights. The remainder of your time may involve team discussions, methodology development, documentation, process improvements, tooling, cross-functional collaboration, or experimentation with new approaches. Who You Are We’re looking for someone who: Enjoys both the design and analytical sides of quantitative research . Likes taking ownership of a research project from an initial question through final findings. Enjoys working with structured processes and becoming better and more efficient at executing them over time, while offering ideas and initiative to improve and streamline them as needed. Is naturally detail-oriented and methodical in their work. Is comfortable troubleshooting and resolving field issues independently, but knows when to escalate larger problems for discussion or review Communicates clearly and asks precise questions when clarifying requirements. Enjoys cross-functional work and being involved in the early stages of a program. What You’ll Need We’re looking for the following qualifications for this role: 2–3+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, market research, survey research, consumer insights, or a closely related field. Hands-on experience designing questionnaires and conducting online survey research. Experience analyzing survey datasets and synthesizing quantitative findings into meaningful conclusions. A solid understanding of survey design fundamentals, including question wording, response scales, questionnaire structure, screening, and common sources of bias. Experience working with survey platforms such as Alchemer, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or similar. Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, statistical software, or other analytical tools to explore and analyze quantitative data. Comfort interpreting percentages, distributions, cross-tabulations, and differences between respondent groups. Ability to communicate findings clearly, in writing, to audiences who may not have a research background. Strong communication skills and a disciplined, detail-oriented working style. You’ll be part of our growing Quant Insights team and will work closely with the Research, Product, Engineering, and Commercial Operations teams, making collaboration essential. Practical Details Location: This is a remote, full-time position from the UK, Ireland, or the EU. Baymard is a registered employer in the UK, IE, and DK. Language: We expect you to be fully proficient in written English. Written English is critical to this role, and you will have to submit your application/cover letter in English. Salary: Based on qualifications and country average. Start date: As soon as possible. Travel: Is limited; expect only 1-2 weeks of travel each year (often only in connection with the company-wide meetup). Company: Learn more about Baymard’s work culture and values here . Also, consider reading this article about our Quantitative Insights work. How to Apply If you’re interested in this position, please apply by sending all of the following documents: A cover letter written in English (PDF format; 1-2 pages) describing how you fit the role and qualifications. (Required.) A CV/resume (PDF format) or a link to your LinkedIn profile. (Required.) Send the above to quant2026@baymard.com. (All applications and materials are treated confidentially.) Deadline is November 15th, 2026 (end of day). Sincerely, Richard Lam, Quant Insights Lead at Baymard Institute Referral Bonus: If this job isn’t you, but you know someone who’ll be the perfect fit, please send them the link to this page. If we end up hiring the person you referred, we’ll give you 12 months of access to a Baymard Expansion plan (normally $4,200/year). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/baymard-institute-market-research-data-analyst
