items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Wyoming, United States URL: http://orchard.co About Orchard 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. About the role What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. Requirements You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native. You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. items.description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager with strong expertise & hands-on experience in server and GPU infrastructure procurement to support our global data center operations. You will operate at a high execution speed and be expected to quickly integrate into ongoing projects. You are welcome to work at our head office in Amsterdam, the Netherlands , or remotely within the EU. Your responsibilities will include: Managing end-to-end procurement of server and GPU infrastructure for new data center builds Negotiating directly with OEM/ODM vendors Creating dashboards and report on existing tasks to ensure all tasks are done in a timely manner within the deadline. Managing cost optimization, supply constraints, and vendor escalations Coordinating closely with engineering, logistics, finance, and operations team Maintenance Procurement: supporting global data centers after go-live, ensuring zero-disruption operations through proactive stock planning, coordinating urgent procurement We expect you to have: At least 5+ years of experience in server / data center hardware procurement Direct experience working with ODM/OEM manufacturers Strong negotiation skills with a history of securing supply commitments and favorable commercial terms in constrained markets Experience operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments Ability to quickly understand technical infrastructure requirements Working proficiency in English It will be an added bonus if you have: Hands-on experience with GPU procurement Experience in hyper-scale / AI infrastructure environments Experience in global procurement operations Familiarity with NetSuite or ERP systems Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

items.summary: Company Overview Pattern (Nasdaq: PTRN) is a leader in accelerating brands on global ecommerce marketplaces, leveraging proprietary technology and AI. items.description: Company Overview Pattern (Nasdaq: PTRN) is a leader in accelerating brands on global ecommerce marketplaces, leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 91 trillion data points, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service, through products like 3P Accelerator, TikTok Shop, PXM, and ROI Hunter. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern's ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 70+ global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. ROI Hunter is Pattern's advertising technology platform, helping brands manage product-level performance across Meta, Google, Snap, TikTok, and now OpenAI's ChatGPT. Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come build with us. We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies in the US to the top of the list. Pattern has been named one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of the best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek's Global Most Loved Workplaces®. We need a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of ecommerce clients across Brazil, helping them turn ROI Hunter's platform into real, measurable results rather than just another dashboard they log into. This is a full-time role and is fully remote, based anywhere in Brazil. Frequently Asked Questions What is a day in the life of a Customer Success Junior? Run bi-weekly or monthly calls with your clients, helping them actually put ROI Hunter's strategies into practice, not just review a dashboard together Manage renewals and spot upsell opportunities as you build out your own portfolio Help clients increase adoption of the platform through training sessions and day-to-day questions Join weekly meetings with the product team to stay current on what's shipping and why Collaborate with product, marketing, and finance whenever something in your accounts calls for it What will I need to thrive in this role? At least 2 years of experience in digital marketing, ideally with direct client or account responsibility Comfortable reading performance data and turning it into a recommendation a client can act on. You don't need deep expertise across Meta, Google, and TikTok, but real hands-on exposure to at least one of them helps a lot Strong communication and presentation skills, and the judgment to be honest with a client about trade-offs rather than overselling what the platform can do Genuinely collaborative. This isn't a role for someone who prefers to solve everything solo, since you'll lean on product, marketing, and finance regularly Strong English language skills are a must due to the international environment we work in Spanish is a plus, not a requirement, given some of Pattern's Brazil-based commercial work touches Spanish-speaking clients What does high performance look like? You're carrying a portfolio of 10 to 15 clients Your clients renew and grow their use of the platform instead of churning Clients stay engaged, test new solutions, and see the platform as delivering real value rather than something they're just paying for You're spotting upsell opportunities before a renewal conversation forces the issue, not scrambling to justify the account at the last minute Clients trust your read on their numbers enough to act on it, even when the honest answer isn't the exciting one You're building case studies highlighting success with customers What is my potential for career growth? You can grow further into a Strategic or a Senior CSM taking more responsibilities and budgets What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days? First month: You will focus on learning the platform itself, getting hands-on rather than just watching from the sidelines. You will go through demo sessions and use them to practice applying ROI Hunter's strategies before you're doing it live in front of a client. Second month: You will shadow other CSMs on their day-to-day work, sitting in on their client calls, watching how they handle renewal conversations and routine questions, and getting a feel for the pace and judgment the role actually takes before you're the one carrying it. Third month: You will start building your own portfolio, taking over client relationships directly and running the calls yourself, putting what you picked up in the first two months into practice in real conversations rather than as an observer. What is the team like? You'll report to Vitória Gomes. During your first three months you'll be paired with a buddy to help you get up to speed. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and inputs are encouraged from all members. Sounds great! What’s the company culture? We are looking for individuals who are: Game Changers : A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes. Data Fanatics : A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. Partner Obsessed : An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. Team of Doers : Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. What is the hiring process? Quick quiz to gauge our mutual match Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team Interview with a hiring manager Practical assignment in the form of a homework Final interview with the hiring manager and our VP of CS An in depth conversation about your career history and experience Professional reference checks Executive review Offer How can I stand out as an applicant? Discuss professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples Provide insights on how you can add value and be the best addition to the team Focus on mentioning how you would be partner-obsessed at Pattern Share experience on any side projects related to data and analytics Compensation Additional Information Why should I work at Pattern? Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include Meal vouchers (BRL 35/working day) Health insurance plan (Sul América) Work from home subsidy (150 EUR/quarter) Education budget 30 days of paid vacation leave per year of service, accrued gradually Quarterly performance bonus Phone plan Company and team events (online & offline) Pattern is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any status protected by local law.

Professional Volunteering: Skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. About Solution Community : is an international 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, pioneering an innovative social platform dedicated to enabling actionable change. With volunteers from 70+ countries, we demonstrate the power of global collaboration. Our team members bring experiences from some of the world's most successful companies, including Apple, Toyota, Google, Netflix, Walmart, Meta, and many others, creating a rich tapestry of knowledge and passion. Our Mission: To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems. We bridge non-profits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers, empowering them to create meaningful change for current and future generations. Our Vision: Imagine a world where every person has the opportunity to thrive — a world united by collaboration, compassion, and action. At Solution Community , we are turning that vision into reality, driving transformative change that reshapes the future. Summary of Role: As our Marketing Project Manager, you will serve as the Growth Team's strategic backbone, bridging analytics, content strategy, and project execution to drive measurable marketing outcomes. You will lead the planning, coordination, and performance tracking of marketing initiatives, ensuring campaigns are data-informed, strategically aligned, and delivered on time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategic analysis and hands-on project management. Responsibilities Define project scopes, timelines, milestones, and deliverables for marketing campaigns and initiatives across all channels. Serve as a strategic guide and decision-maker in content strategy, ensuring all content aligns with organizational goals and audience insights. Design and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure campaign performance, engagement metrics, and ROI across platforms. Collaborate with the social media, design, paid ads, and brand outreach teams to ensure alignment, remove blockers, and maintain delivery cadence. Translate data into actionable insights, identifying opportunities to optimize, grow audiences, and improve content performance. Oversee end-to-end execution of marketing projects from ideation through launch and post-campaign analysis. Build and refine marketing workflows, templates, and operational systems that scale with team growth. Provide regular updates, status reports, and strategic recommendations to the Head of Growth and leadership. Qualifications - You are a good fit if: You bring experience in marketing strategy, analytics, or project management with a proven ability to translate vision into measurable outcomes. You are data-driven and comfortable building dashboards, interpreting campaign metrics, and making evidence-based decisions. You have experience coordinating multiple workstreams, managing timelines, and driving cross-functional teams toward shared goals. Understanding of content ecosystems, audience segmentation, and how strategic content drives engagement and growth. You excel at presenting insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are passionate about social impact and motivated to contribute your skills to a purpose-driven, global organization. You are familiar with project management tools, analytics platforms (Google Analytics, social media insights), and content planning tools. What We Offer Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies Meaningful impact on global causes and communities A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration Flexible work life with full autonomy Opportunities for personal and professional growth A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term. items.title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) E-Commerce Agentur · Remote
items.summary: Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen?
items.description: Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen? Du denkst in zusammenhängenden System, steuerst komplexe Organisationen und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Konzepte nicht auf Folien bleiben, sondern im Tagesgeschäft gelebt werden? Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams. Das erwartet dich bei uns Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten. Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann. Über EVOLVE Digital EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse. EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten. Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen. Deine Aufgaben im Überblick Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran. Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe. Was das im Alltag heißt: Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar. Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding. Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind. Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung. Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben. Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Bottlenecks im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- und Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n. Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt. Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, da wir 100 % remote arbeiten. Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Team Leads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen. Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen. Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen. Was wir dir bieten Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations 100 % Remote-Arbeit Attraktives Gehalt und 30 Tage Urlaub Umfangreiches Benefitprogramm, einschließlich einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterbenefits, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass Sicherer Arbeitsplatz und eine langfristige Perspektive mit der Möglichkeit, sich zum COO weiterzuentwickeln Kollegiale und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und offener Feedbackkultur Umfangreiche fachliche Fortbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten Moderne Arbeitsgeräte, inklusive Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertigem Zubehör für das Homeoffice. 2x jährlich stattfindende Teamevents / Workations Nächste Schritte & Ansprechpartner Ansprechpartner: Dein erster Kontakt ist Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin und sie freut sich schon darauf dich kennen zu lernen. So wirst du Teil unseres Teams: Du willst Teil unseres Teams werden? Dann bewirb dich jetzt direkt. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Job Title Project Monitoring Officer Location Global Position Type Paid - Regular Job Description The Project Monitoring Officer plays a critical role in supporting SIL's expanding Resource Development strategy by ensuring the effective coordination, monitoring, and reporting of projects that support organizational and staff fundraising efforts. As SIL continues to grow its network of donors, grantors, and funding partners, this position serves as a central hub for collecting and managing project information, facilitating collaboration across departments, and ensuring that project proposals and reports meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and donor compliance. This globally focused role is responsible for overseeing the systematic collection, analysis, tracking, and reporting of project data to support grant management, fundraising initiatives, and strategic decision-making. The Project Monitoring Officer works closely with project leaders, fundraisers, and organizational stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, monitor project progress, measure outcomes, and provide timely reporting that strengthens donor relationships and demonstrates impact. Additionally, the position serves as a key liaison between SIL and ETEN Alliance, fostering strong partnership engagement, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring alignment of shared goals and reporting requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, relationship-oriented, and motivated by supporting successful fundraising outcomes that enable SIL to advance its mission and expand its global impact. Responsibilities Project Intake, Proposal Development, and Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for Areas, SCOs, and project leaders regarding project intake, proposal development, and reporting requirements. Manage project intake processes to ensure submitted projects have appropriate leadership endorsement, align with organizational priorities, demonstrate funding potential, and support measurable outcomes. Review and strengthen project concept notes, project descriptions, impact statements, and budgets to meet donor and funding partner expectations. Coordinate with project leaders and stakeholders to gather information necessary for proposal development and donor communications. Facilitate ongoing communication regarding project expectations, reporting requirements, accountability measures, and funding opportunities. Collaborate with internal departments to collect project stories, impact narratives, testimonials, and related content for donor reports, annual reports, websites, email campaigns, and stewardship communications. Project Registry and Reporting Management Maintain a comprehensive project registry and filing system that serves as the central repository for project information, proposals, reports, donor requirements, and related documentation. Manage project tracking systems, including funding coordination, proposal status, reporting schedules, and project documentation. Maintain reporting calendars and proactively communicate reporting deadlines to project leaders and funding recipients. Coordinate the collection, review, and submission of financial and narrative reports in accordance with donor agreements and organizational requirements. Support the development, formatting, editing, and distribution of project proposals and progress reports using approved organizational templates and standards. Ensure project files remain current, organized, and accessible to authorized stakeholders. Track donor requirements, reporting obligations, giving page support needs, and process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness. Funding Administration Support Coordinate project-related donation processing activities with gift administration and finance teams. Support accurate allocation of project funding, indirect cost recovery, and funding transfers. Maintain project funding records and update project tracking systems accordingly. Communicate project awards, funding decisions, reporting expectations, and compliance requirements to project recipients. Monitor project financial activity to support accurate reporting and donor accountability. Alliance Partnership Management Serve as a primary liaison between related partners. Maintain regular communication and engagement processes that support strong partner relationships and coordinated action. Represent SIL priorities, constraints, and outcomes in partnership discussions while ensuring partner expectations are clearly communicated internally. Establish and maintain systems to track funded activities, grant commitments, deliverables, and reporting obligations. Curate, validate, manage, and analyze project and operational data associated with funded activities. Generate reports, dashboards, and data insights to support grant reporting, organizational learning, performance evaluation, and strategic decision-making. Facilitate proposal development, grant reporting, project implementation tracking, and compliance monitoring across multiple departments and partner organizations. Ensure partnership commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule. Skills and Abilities Strong project coordination and project management capabilities while managing multiple priorities Excellent organizational, planning, and deadline-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and departments. Proficiency in preparing, editing, formatting, and reviewing proposals, reports, and project documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Competence in data collection, tracking, reporting, and analysis. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and commitment to continuous improvement. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Nonprofit Management or related field preferred Travel Requirements Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, including attendance at approved in-person meetings, training events, and partner engagements. Weekly Hours 40 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philadelphia, PA, USA URL: https://logicstics.com Remote | Full-Time Logicstics is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing & Google Ads / AI Search Specialist to take ownership of our online lead generation strategy. We are an international moving and logistics company serving customers relocating throughout the world. This is a hands-on position. We are looking for someone who can build, manage, analyze, and improve campaigns themselves, not simply coordinate with outside agencies. What You'll Do You will be responsible for increasing qualified leads while continuously improving our cost per acquisition and overall marketing ROI. Your responsibilities will include: Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, and remarketing Conduct keyword research and continuously improve PPC campaign structure, targeting, bidding, ad copy, and landing pages Monitor CPL, CPA, conversion rates, ROAS, impression share, search terms, and other performance metrics Develop and execute our organic SEO strategy Perform technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO Identify content and keyword opportunities based on search intent Improve rankings for high-value international moving and logistics searches Develop strategies for AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews/Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search platforms Improve how Logicstics and its content are discovered, cited, and recommended by AI search engines Research emerging GEO/AEO/LLM optimization strategies and test what actually produces results Create content strategies designed for both traditional search engines and AI search Work with our developers to improve landing pages, conversion tracking, site structure, schema, page speed, and technical SEO Build dashboards and reporting that clearly show leads, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and marketing ROI Identify new digital channels and lead-generation opportunities Use AI and automation tools to improve marketing research, content workflows, analysis, and campaign performance What We're Looking For: You should have proven hands-on experiece with: Google Ads and PPC campaign management Google Analytics 4 Google Search Console Google Tag Manager SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms Technical and on-page SEO Keyword research and competitor analysis Conversion tracking and attribution Landing page optimization and CRO Lead-generation campaigns AI tools used for marketing, research, analysis, and content creation AI search optimization, GEO, AEO, or a strong understanding of how brands gain visibility in generative search Experience marketing international moving, logistics, freight forwarding, transportation, relocation, or other high-value service businesses is a major advantage. What Matters Most We are not looking for someone who measures success by traffic, impressions, or the number of articles published. We care about qualified leads and profitable customer acquisition . You should be comfortable looking at a campaign and answering questions such as: Which keywords are generating booked customers? What are we paying for those customers? Where are we wasting money? Which organic pages generate actual inquiries? Why are competitors appearing in AI search results when we aren't? What should we change this month to generate more business? Requirements 3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience Demonstrable results managing Google Ads campaigns Strong SEO knowledge Strong analytical skills Excellent written English Experience working independently in a remote environment Ability to manage projects and meet deadlines without constant supervision Comfortable learning and testing emerging AI marketing technologies How to Apply Interested candidates should submit their resume and complete the required video interview as part of the application process. We're interested in what you've accomplished, not simply the tools you've used. Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted to schedule a live interview with our team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/logicstics-digital-marketing-google-ads-ai-search-specialist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. Campaign Oversight & Reporting Monitoring key metrics across every project - connect rate, reply rate, conversion rate - as your own numbers, not someone else's dashboard. Feeding structured feedback to Research, Content, and EDS so lead quality and messaging actually improve, not just flagging that something isn't working. Keeping CRM hygiene tight in HubSpot and sharing a weekly recap your Account Strategist can actually use. What You Bring: 2+ years of outbound SDR experience with a strong cold calling background ; Fluent English - written and spoken - comfortable working across US and European time zones; Metrics-driven: you track your dials, connect rates, and conversion numbers and know how to improve them; Strong objection handling and a consistent track record of landing next steps; Comfortable working brand-new accounts with no track record yet, and able to manage multiple pilot-stage client projects in parallel without losing quality or pace; Reliable CRM hygiene and disciplined follow-up across all open threads; Self-starting and proactive - you hold your pace without needing external pressure. How We Hire: Recruiter Interview (~30 minutes) — with Yuliia or Inna. Practical Task (~60–90 minutes) — a written exercise covering outbound thinking, objection handling, and lead prioritization. Hiring Manager Interview (~45–60 minutes) — a conversation with the SDR Enablement Manager covering the details of your work, performance analytics, and a live cold-call roleplay. Final Interview (~60 minutes) — with the Managing Director and HR Business Partner to assess company fit and explore your values and working style. Offer & Onboarding — if it's a yes, we move fast. *We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. Final decisions are made by humans. Contact us for information on data processing. At Belkins, we care deeply about our team members, and we prove it through: Competitive Pay: Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise. Remote-First Flexibility: We’ve transitioned to a fully remote environment so you can work where you're most productive. Our flexible hours help you stay agile and focused. Professional Growth: We’re a launchpad for your career. Through regular feedback, 1:1s, internal mobility, and knowledge-sharing, your growth is enabled and celebrated. We also maintain an internal wiki for insights and a library of the latest business books to keep you sharp. Well-being focus: Your mental health is a priority. We offer mental health lectures and support for your overall well-being. Recharge Time: We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs. Global Sync: We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync. Memorable Team Experiences: Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/belkins-sales-development-representative-intake-pod

items.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Product (API & MCP)
items.summary: SE Ranking, an all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform, is seeking a Senior Product Manager to scale our Data Product - our API and MCP offering - from early traction into a repeatable, scalable revenue line.
items.description: SE Ranking , an all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform, is seeking a Senior Product Manager to scale our Data Product - our API and MCP offering - from early traction into a repeatable, scalable revenue line. We've already gone from 0 to 1: we have paying API customers, a fast-growing MCP that recently overtook our classic API in daily unique users, and partners building agentic workflows on top of our data. Now we need someone to own the entire revenue funnel and turn that momentum into further growth of MCP usage and Data MRR. If you get excited about turning a data & developer product into a growth engine - and about making SE Ranking the marketing intelligence infrastructure for AI agents - then this role is for you. Key Responsibilities: You will report directly to Mike Korenugin , VP of Product, and own the entire funnel for the Data Product (API + MCP) : from acquisition and activation, to sales enablement, to onboarding, retention, and expansion. You'll drive two connected revenue engines - net-new MRR from API and Data customers, and net dollar retention (NDR) by embedding MCP and agentic workflows into the core SEO jobs our customers do every day. You'll lead a focused squad with Aleksander Germatsky as your Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers Dominik Stypula and Mikhail Liubushkin shipping the endpoints, infrastructure, and developer experience that make the product sell and stick. On go-to-market, you'll partner daily with Valentyna Havryliuk , our PMM driving API & MCP adoption, and with Alexey Trusevich , the dedicated Account Executive for the Data Product. Beyond your squad, you'll work closely with Demand Gen, SEO, Growth, and PR on getting the product discovered and promoted; with Sales & Success and Support on closing and retaining customers; and with the Data team on coverage, accuracy, and the endpoints customers ask for. Your job is to connect all of these into one growth motion. Initial Focus Areas: Craft a strategy for Data Product with two goals in mind Grow Data revenue : understand our current packaging and pricing gaps across plans & products, the PAYG funnel, and credit packs; define a clear, repeatable motion for upmarket deals. Define the inputs (acquisition, activation, expansion) that move the number and hold the product to them. Drive MCP usage and capabilities: own the MCP adoption track as a strong NDR lever. Scale the adoption flows and lifecycle upsells, close capability gaps customers hit, and make the Claude, ChatGPT, and n8n connector experiences feel amazing. Ramp up solution engineering for Sales & Success: we’ve got a new person starting as solution engineer and strong L3 technical support, but they would often need your help and insight to unblock AEs and CSMs on credit provisioning, key generation, quota changes, connector troubleshooting; and translating prospect requirements into solutions that win deals. Learn how Demand Gen & Outbound is connected to Product: partner with PMM and Demand Gen to scale what's working - workshops and MCP bootcamps, ABM, spokespeople and influencer content, PR, and SEO - and to sharpen the website. Help us find exciting API/MCP use cases from top clients and influencers and turn them into content and sales enablement assets. Long-Term Responsibilities: Make the Data Product a repeatable, scalable revenue line: evolve packaging, pricing, and the self-serve funnel so growth doesn't depend on heroics. Use signals from won and lost deals, usage, and feedback to generate strong hypotheses and continuously improve win rates, activation, and expansion. Grow MCP into the default "agentic SEO" workflow: keep MCP workflows healthy and lead the move from data to action, so customers believe SE Ranking is the way to automate SEO with AI agents - defending NDR and opening natural paths to expansion and win-back. Build a real solution-engineering function: grow from firefighting into a system - documentation, tooling, and onboarding that let customers discover and integrate our API and MCP, and let Sales & Success move fast without engineering in the loop. Expand endpoint & data coverage from the voice of the customer: translate prospect and customer feedback into a prioritized roadmap for new endpoints and data (e.g. URL-level GSC, prompt generation, Local Marketing and AIRT coverage), and partner with the Data team on accuracy and the questions buyers ask about how the data is sourced and validated. Be a strategic GTM partner across teams: surface trade-offs, unblock cross-team dependencies, and keep Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Success, and Data aligned as priorities and timelines shift. We are destined to be if you have: Launched new B2B products and taken them from 0 to 1 , leading Sales Enablement and deeply engaging with Demand Gen to achieve GTM success. Owned a revenue funnel end to end - acquisition, activation, sales enablement, onboarding, retention, and expansion - and know how to grow TOFU and help close deals. Built API-first or data products that offer a great self-served developer experience but don't completely puzzle out business stakeholders. Hands-on, practical AI experience and genuine excitement about MCP and agentic workflows - and ideas about how a data product becomes the tool of choice inside tools like Claude and Codex. Acted as a technical partner to Sales & Success , supporting demos, prospect setups, and troubleshooting, and turning that into product and tooling improvements. Either direct experience in SEO / AI Search , or a track record of ramping quickly in a new and technical domain - and the appetite to do so here. Explained complex concepts and strategies so that your team, fellow PMs, Designers, Senior Leaders, Support, Success, and Sales reps as well as users all understood you easily. Managed stakeholders' expectations with grace as delivery dates shift and plans change. Embraced the constant change of a startup. Great spoken English. * If you feel strongly that you have what it takes for this role but don't technically tick all the boxes - apply anyway, just highlight what you'd bring to the table. Tools we use for work: Self-served product analytics: Amplitude, PowerBI, Grafana In-app guides and surveys: Amplitude, Typeform Session replay: LogRocket User feedback: Enterpret, Avoma, Zendesk tickets & NPS, Brightback Tasks, roadmaps, documentation: Linear, Miro, Notion Communication: Slack Claude Code / Cowork to bring it all together. What we offer: 22 days of paid time off, plus your local national holidays Flexible work hours and a culture that trusts you to manage your time Private medical insurance or a medical allowance (depending on your location) Extended paid sick leave so you can fully recover without worry Career map with growth opportunities Support for wellbeing and L&D Best hardware for your work (team Apple) An award-winning product loved by thousands of customers worldwide A transparent, flexible culture with people at the core of everything we do Events that are actually fun Originally posted on Himalayas

About Kairos Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent i
items.description: Join Kairos’s new Special Projects team to help launch and run the tactical projects we take on. Depending on experience, we consider candidates for the Generalist (Special Projects) or Senior Generalist (Special Projects) version of this role. We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis. About Kairos Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs: SPAR : The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others. Generator Residency : In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from OpenAI, AI Futures Project, METR, and more. Global Challenges Project : A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley. Pathfinder Fellowship : Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work. We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem. The Role Kairos has historically made a small number of large, ongoing bets, like SPAR and Pathfinder. We’ve learned that a surprising number of time-bound opportunities are worth pursuing too, whether that’s an event, a one-off program, or a project that responds to a narrow window for impact. Our new Special Projects team exists to go after them, and we’re looking for a generalist to help get its projects off the ground. Some of these projects will be short-lived by design. Others may become lasting programs. Generator went from an idea to a 27-resident cohort at Constellation in a matter of months, and Talent Commons, our shared talent database, will likely become a core part of how Kairos, and much of the AI safety ecosystem, routes talent. You’d work closely with our Head of Special Projects, doing what each project’s stage needs most, whether that’s recruiting the first participants, running a pilot’s operations, building the systems behind it, or helping figure out whether the idea works at all. What You’ll Do Help launch new projects. You’ll work on one or two early-stage projects at a time, taking on whatever they need to get off the ground. Build the systems behind them. You’ll set up the infrastructure new projects run on, like applications, communications, and automations, so a pilot can grow into a program. Grow with the work. You’ll take on more ownership as projects mature, and the shape of the role will evolve with your strengths and interests. Pitch in on broader Kairos work as capacity allows. You’ll help on active programs like SPAR, Pathfinder, and Generator, build relationships across the AI safety ecosystem, and ship small cross-team projects. Who You Are You want to do many things well , pick up new domains quickly, and work on whatever is most useful rather than settle into a fixed lane. High agency. Early-stage projects come with little structure. You figure out what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be asked. Fast and scrappy. You ship quickly, iterate as you learn, and are okay with unglamorous operational work along the way. Mission-aligned with context on AI safety. You care deeply about making advanced AI go well, and you’re familiar enough with the ecosystem to understand the gaps our new projects aim to fill. Why Work With Us You’ll be working toward reducing risks from advanced AI, potentially the most important challenge of our time. The projects you help build could become Kairos’s next core programs and address critical bottlenecks in AI safety. Few roles offer this much variety. You’ll touch several programs and projects in your first year, and we’ll shape the role around your comparative advantage. We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people who’ve come to Kairos from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, the UK AI Security Institute, and CEA who share your commitment to impact. Collaborate regularly with leading AI safety researchers, policy professionals, funders, and organizers. What We Offer Salary : $105,000–$145,000 (baseline), $130,000–$180,000 (supported hubs, like London, DC, Boston, and NYC), or $145,000–$200,000 (San Francisco Bay Area), depending on experience, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates Location : This is a remote role. We provide access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, with optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in one of these cities, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses. If you work from home, we cover home office expenses. Benefits : Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture. Travel: Work-related travel and expenses covered. Logistics Start date : Flexible, though we generally expect new hires to be able to start within a couple of months of applying Remote, with expected travel 3–6 times a year for conferences and events, predominantly in the US We’d also be happy for you to work out of any of the AI safety hubs in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston. We prefer candidates who can attend meetings in the ET time zone (though our team currently spans GMT-8 to GMT+1). Kairos is happy to sponsor visas to the US (typically H-1Bs or O-1As) and will likely be able to sponsor UK visas in the coming months. We can’t guarantee visa approvals, however. Our Culture We’re a small, high-trust team motivated by the urgent challenge of making advanced AI go well. We try hard to figure out where we’re wrong, which means we say uncomfortable things to each other and change our minds fairly often. We value collaborative truth-seeking, a scout mindset, agility, and an alliance mindset with the broader ecosystem. We also believe meaningful work should be enjoyable. We support each other’s well-being, celebrate wins, and maintain a healthy sense of humor even when the work is hard. Application Process We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis. Application form (10–20 mins) Take-home assignment (2–4 hours, paid) Interview (45 mins) Reference checks Work trial (3 days, paid) Offer If you’re excited about this role but unsure whether you meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re interested in multiple roles, apply to the one that best fits your skills and interests, and note in your application the other roles that you’d like to be considered for. This role’s scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply. AI tools help us review applications. If we receive more apps than we can read, some may be declined based on the AI review alone. Learn more → Questions? Reach out at Know someone who might be a good fit? If your referral gets hired and completes two months with us, we’ll pay you a $10,000 referral bonus. Learn more here . Compensation: $105K – $200K • Multiple Ranges Most locations (baseline) • $105K – $145K London, DC, Boston, NYC • $130K – $180K San Francisco Bay Area • $145K – $200K Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.title: HMDA Specialist
items.summary: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and experienced HMDA Specialist to join our team.
items.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and experienced HMDA Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accurate collection, validation, and reporting of loan data in compliance with the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) . This position requires deep familiarity with the mortgage origination process and a strong ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Review, analyze, and validate loan application data for HMDA reporting compliance. Maintain data integrity and ensure timely submission of the LAR (Loan Application Register). Identify and resolve HMDA data discrepancies across loan files and systems. Monitor the accuracy of demographic, disposition, and transactional data in Encompass. Collaborate with internal teams including processing, underwriting, and compliance to ensure HMDA-related issues are properly documented and resolved. Generate ad hoc reports from Encompass as needed to support audits, quality control, and operational needs. Stay up-to-date with changes to HMDA regulation and advise the team accordingly. Assist with internal and external audits or regulatory examinations related to HMDA compliance. Support ongoing training and education of staff to promote HMDA awareness and compliance best practices. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Proficiency in Encompass and strong understanding of its functionality as it relates to HMDA data. Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills including: Adding columns and reformatting spreadsheets Filtering data Performing basic formulas (subtraction, IF statements, VLOOKUP) Strong understanding of the mortgage origination process , from application through processing, underwriting, and closing Familiarity with loan documentation and the data fields critical to HMDA reporting. Solid knowledge of the adverse loan process , including: Denials Withdrawn applications Closed for incompleteness Approved but not accepted transactions Ability to think critically and solve problems creatively , without full reliance on a predefined checklist or process. High attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating cross-functionally within the organization. 2+ years of direct HMDA reporting experience within a mortgage lending environment. Prior experience in a compliance, quality control, or mortgage operations role. Familiarity with additional compliance regulations (e.g., ECOA, RESPA, TRID) is a plus. Benefits Above market salary HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents Government-mandated benefits Performance-based Incentives Quarterly Company Events 1,000 PHP De Minimis Equipment and software provided Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
items.summary: This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our growing brands at saas.group. For nearly a decade, Prerender has helped marketers build dynamic, complex JavaScript websites at scale while keeping them fully visible to search engines and AI platforms. We remove crawling and indexing limits so our customers' content can be found, ranked…
items.description: This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our growing brands at saas.group . For nearly a decade, Prerender has helped marketers build dynamic, complex JavaScript websites at scale while keeping them fully visible to search engines and AI platforms. We remove crawling and indexing limits so our customers' content can be found, ranked and cited, whether on Google's search results or in AI-powered answers from tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. More than 100,000 websites around the globe trust Prerender to serve more than 2.7 billion web pages to crawlers, improving their organic rankings and AI visibility. Profile Overview As a Senior Customer Success Manager at Prerender, you make sure our customers stay, grow and succeed with us. You own retention and churn for a defined book of enterprise and mid-market accounts, and you're measured on how well that book retains. You use data to spot risk early, reach out before problems surface, and show customers the business value Prerender delivers. This is a highly customer-focused role at the point where technology meets business. You'll explain what rendering, crawling and indexing mean for a customer's traffic, visibility and revenue. You'll also bring what you learn from customers back to our Product, Support and Marketing teams so we keep getting better. If you like building trusted relationships, working from data, and making technical topics simple, you'll thrive here. Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be: Build trusted relationships with assigned customers, understand their challenges and how Prerender can help Start acting as an advisor on machine/AI visibility as Prerender repositions itself out of the pure SEO/rendering space. After about a year, you should have measurably helped retain customers, understood early warning signals, and used the team's diagnostic/signal tooling to proactively reach out before issues escalate. Your responsibilities Own retention for your account book: Take ownership of the retention and churn metrics (e.g. gross revenue retention and logo churn) for a defined book of accounts. Track them, report on them, and drive the actions that move them. Drive proactive retention: Use usage data, health scores and risk signals to spot churn risk early, and run structured retention playbooks instead of waiting for tickets. Turn technical results into business value: Explain Prerender's impact in terms your customers care about: indexing, organic traffic, AI-search visibility and revenue. Build lasting trust: Hold regular check-ins and business reviews that keep customers seeing, and getting, value from Prerender. Be the voice of the customer: Bring feedback, churn reasons and feature gaps back to Product, Support and Marketing in a structured way. Partner across teams: Work closely with Account Managers, Support and Engineering so every customer gets a joined-up experience. How We Work At Prerender, Customer Success is proactive, data-informed and focused on outcomes. We don't wait for customers to come to us. Think in outcomes: Success means the customer reached their goals, not just that a ticket was closed. Build shared context: You make sure teams understand what customers need and why. Scale what works: You help turn good one-off actions into repeatable playbooks. High trust, high ownership: You're trusted to run your book your way. A Typical Day Might Involve Reviewing account health dashboards and picking out who needs attention this week Reaching out to a customer whose usage has dropped before it turns into churn risk Running a business review that shows a customer the SEO and AI-search impact of rendering Helping a customer's developer understand a setup or caching question, and escalating to Engineering with clear context when needed Briefing an Account Manager on account health and value delivered ahead of a renewal Sharing customer feedback and trends with Product Refining a retention playbook based on what you've learned What You bring to the table Proven experience: 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company in marketing, advertising, SEO or martech Retention mindset: A track record of owning retention or churn targets for a book of accounts, and of reducing churn and keeping customers engaged Data-driven, AI-fluent approach: Comfortable working with usage data, health scores and CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot), and using AI assistants connected to your tools and data to make decisions and automate routine work Business translator: You can turn technical details into clear business value for non-technical and technical stakeholders alike Strong communicator: Clear and confident in writing and on calls, in fluent English Structured and proactive: You plan your work, follow through, and don't wait to be told Trusted advisor: Warm, patient and a good listener who cares about customer outcomes. Customers enjoy working with you, and you're confident starting conversations and leading calls. Bonus: Technical product fluency. It helps if you're tech-savvy and familiar with SEO, JavaScript websites, web crawlers, caching or web performance. We're happy to invest in training you on our product, so curiosity and willingness to learn matter more than specific technical expertise. What’s in it for You Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like. Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it. Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable. Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around. Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally. Latest AI tools: You'll be equipped with the latest AI tools to work smarter, automate the repetitive parts, and spend more time with customers. AI growth support: Through saas.group , you'll get support and learning resources to build your AI skills. Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed. Prerender is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together. What is saas.group? Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work. Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company. We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient! — saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply. We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As…
items.description: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Senior Product Designer , you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship. You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders. It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling. You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated. What You'll Do: Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities. Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices. Work closely with Research, Product Management, and Development: request and apply insights, align on business requirements, and validate technical feasibility. Write clear specifications so design intent is unambiguous, and run design QA against both the intent and the Kinsta Design System. Give clear rationale for your decisions, resolve design and product deadlocks, escalate when you need feedback or mediation, and communicate trade-offs when priorities compete. Serve as Project Owner on occasion. We don't have full-time delivery managers, so one team member leads each project as its Owner during delivery, communicating progress and coordinating releases. Be a product expert: know how our product works, the personas and use cases we support, and how that translates into UI-level design solutions. Represent the craft: uphold professional standards in design thinking, problem solving, usability, UX, and UI; give and receive design critique; and help maintain and evolve the Kinsta Design System. What You Bring To The Role: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience as a Product or UX Designer. Demonstrated experience shipping products and features from zero to production, with the ability to carry a project fully autonomously. Experience working in a SaaS environment, on a highly technical product, in cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience across the full design workflow: research, problem definition, ideation and facilitation, creating UI, and partnering in delivery. Expert-level proficiency with Figma. Experience working with and maintaining a design system. A portfolio with at least one case study taking a project from a problem statement to a delivered solution. We want to see your process and how you arrived at decisions, not only screens and a general workflow description. A good understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JS). You don't need to write production code, but you should have a working sense of feasibility and be comfortable poking at things in an Inspector. Proactivity: you take the initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do. Professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bonus if you have: Experience working on a hosting or web infrastructure product. Experience with technical products where the audience is developers or technology-oriented users. Experience with the WordPress ecosystem. Experience mentoring or leading other designers. Benefits: Annual remote expense budget. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA. Compensation Additional Information Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy , including the transfer of your data to the United States. #LI-Remote, #IHSRemote

items.description: Haut.AI is a pioneering BeautyTech startup at the forefront of personalized skincare solutions. We combine scientific research with artificial intelligence to deliver innovative solutions that actually work. Backed by leading European VCs and founded by AI scientists, we are positioned at the intersection of two explosive growth markets: AI and beauty tech. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience of our core product: an AI-powered skin analysis SaaS platform used by beauty brands, retailers, clinics, and wellness and longevity apps. What You'll Do: Own end-to-end design for the SaaS platform: discovery, user flows, prototypes and shipped UI. Design the consumer-facing skin analysis experience: capture, results, skin scores and product recommendations. It has to work across web and mobile, and stay customizable for each client’s brand.
